Yah project isliye shuru hua ki sadak tatha rail se hota maal bhejna mehanga tatha pradushan failane wala tha, isliye jal ke raste se kheti tatha karkhane ka maal sasta tatha paryavaran ke liye behtar hokar pahunchta hai; ise Vishva Bank ki sahayata bhi mili.Sadak, pul tatha bandargah par kaam karne wali yojanaen anya mission hain, isliye jal margon ke vikas ka naam unmein nahi hai. Exam point: antardeshiy jal margon ke vikas ka mission Jal Marg Vikas Project hai - yahi jal se sasta tatha paryavaran hitaishi parivahan deta hai.

qe: Under 'PM SVANidhi', what is the repayment period for the first loan of Rs. 10,000?
qh: 'पीएम स्वानिधि' के तहत 10,000 रुपये के पहले ऋण की चुकौती अवधि क्या है?
e: PM SVANidhi ke tehat diye jaane wale pehle karz 10,000 rupaye ki chukaut ek varsh mein karni hoti hai; ise mahine ke hisaab se chhote-chhote kiston mein bhi chukaya ja sakta hai. Yah avadhi isliye rakhi gayi ki talab wale ki rozana kamai se bhi aisi chukaut aasaani se ho jaaye tatha samay par bhugtan karne par use agli baar 20,000 tatha uske baad 50,000 rupaye ka karz milta hai; samay par bhugtan par byaj par bhi chhoot milti hai. 3 saal, 2 saal ya 6 mahine wale vikalp is karz ki sahi avadhi nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PM SVANidhi ke pehle 10,000 rupaye ke karz ki chukaut ek varsh mein hoti hai - yahi samay par chukane par bada karz khol deti hai.

qe: The 'Mahila E-Haat' portal was launched by which ministry?
qh: 'महिला ई-हाट' पोर्टल किस मंत्रालय द्वारा लॉन्च किया गया था?
o: Ministry of Women and Child Development
e: Mahila E-Haat portal ko Mahila tatha Bal Vikas Mantralaya ne launch kiya tha; ismein mahilaon dwara banaye utpadon ki online bikri ki suvidha di jaati hai. Yah portal isliye bana ki gaon tatha chhote shahar ki mahila ka hunar bazaar tak nahi pahunch paata tha, isliye online manch unko grahak se seedha jodta hai tatha beech wale ka faayda khatam hota hai; ismein prashikshan tatha bazaar ki jankari bhi milti hai. MSME, kapda ya vitta mantralaya wale vikalp is portal ke sahi sanchalak nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: Mahila E-Haat portal Mahila tatha Bal Vikas Mantralaya ne launch kiya - yahi mahilaon ke utpadon ko online bazaar deta hai.

qe: Which scheme aims to provide financial support to startups via a fund of funds?
qh: फंड ऑफ फंड्स के माध्यम से स्टार्टअप्स को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने का लक्ष्य किस योजना का है?
e: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme ke tehat fund of funds ke zariye startup ko shuruaati punji (seed capital) milti hai; yahi rakam unhe proof of idea, prototype, utpad parikshan tatha bazaar mein utarne ke liye milti hai tatha iske liye kisi bhi bade gearan ki zarurat nahi hoti. Yah sahara isliye diya jaata hai ki naye udyam ko shuru mein niveshkar nahi milte, isliye sarkar ki yahi seed money ushe khada hone mein madad karti hai tatha aage niji punji laane mein sahyog karti hai. MUDRA chhote karobar, Stand-Up India SC/ST-mahila udyami tatha PMEGP bade udyog ke liye hai, isliye wo alag hain. Exam point: fund of funds ke zariye startup ko seed fund Startup India Seed Fund Scheme deti hai - yahi shuruaati punji se naye udyam ko khada karti hai.

qe: What is the primary objective of the 'O-SMART' scheme?
qh: 'ओ-स्मार्ट' (O-SMART) योजना का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Ocean services, modeling, applications, and technology
e: O-SMART yojana ka poora aashay Ocean Services, Modelling, Applications, Resources and Technology hai; ismein samundri jankari ikattha karna, mausam tatha samundar ka model banana tatha tsunamis jaisi ghatnaon ki chetavani dena shamil hai. Yah karyakram isliye zaroori hai ki bharat ke paas 7,500 kilometre lamba samundri tatiy kshetra hai tatha machhli, tufan tatha bandargah se jude logon ko sahi jankari chahiye, isliye yahi yojana samudri adhyayan tatha taknik ko ek saath le chalti hai. Jaivik kheti, online padhai ya smart shahar wale vikalp is yojana ke sahi vishay nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: O-SMART yojana samundri sevaon, modelon, anuprayogon tatha taknik se judi hai - yahi samundri jankari tatha chetavani deti hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched for the 'Digitalization of Land Records' in India?
qh: भारत में 'भूमि अभिलेखों के डिजिटलीकरण' के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Bhoomi abhilekhon ke digitalikaran ke liye DILRMP yani Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme shuru kiya gaya; iske tehat zameen ke kagaz, nakal tatha sarkari record computer par la kar unhe ek jagah joda jaata hai. Yah program isliye chala ki kagaz ke puraane record se zameen ke jhagde tatha nakli daastavez badhte the, isliye digital record se kisaan ko karz lene tatha khareed-farokht mein aasaani hoti hai tatha vivaad kam hote hain. PMGSY sadak, PMAY aawas tatha SVAMITVA gaon ki aabadi wali zameen ke nakshe se juda hai, isliye wo teeno alag hain. Exam point: bhoomi abhilekhon ke digitalikaran ki yojana DILRMP hai - yahi zameen ke record ko computer par la kar jhagde ghatata hai.

qe: Under 'Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana' (PMKVY), who is the implementing agency?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री कौशल विकास योजना' (PMKVY) के तहत कार्यान्वयन एजेंसी कौन सी है?
e: PMKVY ke tehat kaushal prashikshan ka kaam National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) ke zariye karaya jaata hai; yahi sanstha prashikshan dene wali agencyon ko chunti hai, paathya tay karti hai tatha chhatra ko manzoori dilati hai. Yah zimma NSDC ko dene ki wajah yahi thi ki sarkar ke paas itne bade paimane par kaushal sikhane ka tantra nahi tha, isliye niji bhaagidaron ke saath milkar yahi kaam tez tatha gunvatta ke saath hota hai; ismein sip tatha short term course dono aate hain. RBI, NITI Aayog ya Grih Mantralaya is yojana ke karyanvayan ki sanstha nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PMKVY ka karyanvayan NSDC karta hai - yahi prashikshan ki agencyon tatha paathya ko chunta hai.

qe: What is the 'PM-Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana' (PMBJP) tagline?
qh: 'पीएम-भारतीय जनऔषधि परियोजना' (PMBJP) का नारा क्या है?
e: PMBJP ka nara 'Sasti Dawa, Achhi Dawa' hai; iska matlab hai ki achhi gunvatta wali jeneik dawa kam daam par milti hai tatha uski gunvatta ki jaanch bhi hoti hai. Yah nara isliye mahatvapurna hai ki aam aadmi ko bharosa dilaya ja sake ki sasti dawa kharaab nahi hoti, isliye yahi yojana Janaushadhi kendron ke zariye gaanv tatha shahar dono jagah ilaj ka kharch ghatati hai tatha doctor ke likhe brand ke bhaav se bachaati hai. Health for All ya Mera Desh, Meri Dawa jaise vikalp is yojana ke sahi nare nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PMBJP ka nara 'Sasti Dawa, Achhi Dawa' hai - yahi sasti tatha achhi jeneik dawa deta hai.

qe: The 'E-RUPI' digital payment solution was launched by which organization?
qh: 'ई-रूपी' (E-RUPI) डिजिटल भुगतान समाधान किस संगठन द्वारा लॉन्च किया गया था?
e: E-RUPI digital payment samadhan ko National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) ne banaya tatha launch kiya tha; yahi sanstha UPI tatha RuPay jaise manch bhi chalati hai. Yah samadhan isliye banaya gaya ki sarkar ya koi sanstha kisi vyakti ko seedha nakad ke bajaye ek QR-code ya SMS wale voucher ke roop mein rakam de sake, jise wo tay kaam par hi kharch kar sake; isse bhugtan ka srot tatha upyog dono ka record rehta hai. SEBI share bazaar, NITI Aayog niti tatha RBI bankon ka kaam dekhta hai, isliye wo teeno is samadhan ke janak nahi hain. Exam point: E-RUPI digital payment samadhan NPCI ne launch kiya - yahi bina nakad seedha laabh pahunchane ka zariya hai.

qe: Which scheme focuses on providing a tap water connection to every urban household?
qh: किस योजना का लक्ष्य प्रत्येक शहरी घर को नल से जल कनेक्शन प्रदान करना है?
e: AMRUT 2.0 ka lakshya shehri kshetra ke pratyek ghar tak nal se jal pahunchana hai; yahi mission paani ki bachat, reuse tatha shehron mein water bodies ke sanrakshan par bhi kaam karta hai. Yah zimma isliye badhaya gaya ki purane AMRUT mein paani ki pahunch tatha kharab naaliyon ka kaam adhoora reh gaya tha, isliye shehron mein pani ki kami tatha bimaari badhti hai; shehri nikay ise paani ki suvidha badhane ke liye istemaal karte hain.Smart Cities, shehri jal mission tatha HRIDAY alag vishyon par kaam karte hain, isliye shehri nal-jal ka lakshya unka nahi hai. Exam point: shehri ghar tak nal se jal pahunchane ka lakshya AMRUT 2.0 ka hai - yahi paani ki bachat tatha reuse par bhi kaam karta hai.

qe: The 'NIPUN Bharat' scheme covers children of which age group?
qh: 'निपुण भारत' योजना किस आयु वर्ग के बच्चों को कवर करती है?
e: NIPUN Bharat mission teen se nau varsh ke bachon ko kaver karta hai; isse pahle ke school tatha anganwadi ke saalon mein padhne, likhne tatha ginti (foundational literacy and numeracy) ki neev tayar ki jaati hai. Yah aayu chuni gayi kyunki cheh saal ki umar tak bachche ki dimaagi tayyari sabse tez hoti hai, isliye is samay sahi tarike se padhai majboot karne se aage ki kaksha mein peeche rehna band ho jaata hai; khel tatha kahaniyon ke zariye sikhaya jaata hai. Das se atharah, cheh se chaudah ya shunya se cheh varsh wale vikalp is mission ke sahi aayu varg nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: NIPUN Bharat mission teen se nau varsh ke bachon ko kaver karta hai - yahi bunyadi padhai tatha ginti majboot karta hai.

qe: Which mission aims to convert 'Barren Land' into fertile through sustainable practices?
qh: सतत प्रथाओं के माध्यम से 'बंजर भूमि' को उपजाऊ बनाने का लक्ष्य किस मिशन का है?
e: National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture ka lakshya banjar tatha kam upjau zameen ko satat (sustainable) tarikon se upjau banana hai; ismein mitti ki jaanch, jal sanrakshan tatha jaivik kheti par jor diya jaata hai. Yah mission isliye chala ki zameen par rasayan tatha bar-bar ek hi fasal ugaane se mitti ki upjaurta ghat ti hai, isliye mitti sanrakshan tatha behtar tarike se hi lambe samay tak paidavar bana rehta hai; jalvayu parivartan se juda anukoolan bhi iska hissa hai. Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana jaivik kheti, Per Drop More Crop drip sinchai tatha Green India Mission jungle se juda hai, isliye wo teeno alag hain. Exam point: banjar bhoomi ko satat tarikon se upjau banane ka kaam National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture ka hai - yahi mitti tatha jal bachaata hai.

qe: What is the maximum subsidy for a SC/ST/Woman entrepreneur in rural areas under 'PMEGP'?
qh: 'PMEGP' के तहत ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में एससी/एसटी/महिला उद्यमी के लिए अधिकतम सब्सिडी क्या है?
e: Grameen kshetra mein SC/ST tatha mahila udyami ke liye PMEGP mein adhiktam paitishat subsidy ka aankda 35 tak jaata hai; yahi seema shehri kshetra ke aise udyamiyon ke liye kam tatha aam shreni ke liye alag hoti hai. Yah adhik subsidy isliye di jaati hai ki in vargon ko punji tatha bank ka bharosa milna mushkil hota hai, isliye sarkar zyada hissa khud uthaakar unka nay udyog shuru karati hai tatha unhe swarozgar deti hai. Pandrah, pachees tatha pachaas pratishat ke aankde is seema se alag shreni ke hain. Exam point: PMEGP mein grameen SC/ST tatha mahila udyami ke liye adhiktam subsidy 35 pratishat hai - yahi unhe bank ka bharosa dilati hai.

qe: The 'SAMARTH' scheme is related to which industry?
qh: 'समर्थ' (SAMARTH) योजना किस उद्योग से संबंधित है?
e: SAMARTH yojana kapda (textile) udyog se judi hai; iske tehat kapda tatha paridhan kshetra mein kaushal vikas, taknik tatha bunakar-craftsman ke kaam par dhyan diya jaata hai. Yah yojana isliye layi gayi ki bharat ka kapda udyog sabse zyada rozgar deta hai par uski product tatha taknik purani thi, isliye yahi karyakram bunakar tatha takniki kapdon mein saphal banane ke liye prashikshan tatha punji ka rasta deta hai. Khady prasansakaran, ispat tatha motor gadi wale vikalp is yojana ke sahi udyog nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: SAMARTH yojana kapda udyog se judi hai - yahi bunakar tatha takniki kapdon ke vikas par kaam karti hai.

qe: Under 'Ayushman Bharat', what is the health cover for senior citizens (70+)?
qh: 'आयुष्मान भारत' के तहत वरिष्ठ नागरिकों (70+) के लिए स्वास्थ्य कवर क्या है?
e: Ayushman Bharat ke tehat 70 varsh tatha usse adhik aayu ke sabhi buzurg nagrikon ke liye alag se 5 lakh rupaye ka vaiyak/adhik health cover diya jaata hai; ise 'Ayushman Vay Vandana' naam se jaana jaata hai. Yah alag cover isliye diya gaya ki is aayu mein ilaj ka kharch sabse zyada hota hai tatha buzurg log aakse kisi yojana ke patra nahi hote, isliye yahi suvidha unhe parivar par bhaar bane bina ilaj karane deti hai. Do lakh tatha das lakh ke aankde anya shreni ke hain; yahan paanch lakh ki alag suvidha hai. Exam point: Ayushman Bharat ke tehat 70 varsh se adhik buzurg nagrikon ko 5 lakh rupaye ka adhik cover milta hai - yahi Vay Vandana ke naam se chalta hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide 'Drone' training to women SHGs?
qh: महिला SHGs को 'ड्रोन' प्रशिक्षण प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Namo Drone Didi yojana ke tehat mahila svayn sahayata samuhon (SHGs) tatha chhote kisaanon ki mahilaon ko drone chalane ka prashikshan diya jaata hai; iske liye unhe drone kharidne par vitti sahayata bhi milti hai. Yah yojana isliye shuru hui ki kheti mein dawa tatha khaad chhidkane ka kaam zyada tar mard karte the tatha yahi kaam samay tatha paisa dono khaata tha, isliye prashikshit didiyan kheti ka kaam kira par kar apni aay badhati hain tatha gaon mein naya rozgar paida hota hai. Digital India, Lakhpati Didi tatha saur pump wali yojana alag kaam karti hain, isliye unhe Drone Didi ka sah naam nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: mahila SHG ko drone prashikshan Namo Drone Didi yojana deti hai - yahi unhe kheti ka naya dhanda tatha aay deti hai.

qe: What is the 'PM-Kisan' income support paid per installment?
qh: 'पीएम-किसान' आय सहायता प्रति किस्त कितनी दी जाती है?
e: PM-KISAN ke tehat sahayata ki rakam teen barabar kisthon mein di jaati hai tatha pratyek kist 2,000 rupaye ki hoti hai; yani saal mein kul 6,000 rupaye chhote tatha seemit kisaanon ko milte hain. Yah rakam isliye aisi tay ki gayi ki beej tatha khaad ka kharch fasal bote samay ek saath aata hai tatha chhote kisaan ko sahukar ke bhaari byaj se bachaya ja sake; rakam seedha uske khate mein DBT se aati hai. 3,000 ya 1,000 wale aankde pratyek kist ki sahi rakam nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PM-KISAN ki pratyek kist 2,000 rupaye ki hoti hai - yahi teen kisthon mein saal ke 6,000 rupaye kisaan ko deti hai.

qe: Which mission is focused on 'Zero Hunger' and reducing food wastage?
qh: 'शून्य भूख' और भोजन की बर्बादी को कम करने पर कौन सा मिशन केंद्रित है?
e: POSHAN 2.0 mission ka lakshya shunya bhookh tatha khaane ki barbadi kam karna hai; yahi karyakram sarkari yojanaon ke paas jaa rahe anaj tatha poshan mein santulan tatha saaf safai jaisi baatein jodta hai. Yah soch isliye aai ki anaaj hota hua bhi bachche kuposhan ke shikar rehte the, isliye yahi mission khaane ki matara tatha gunvatta dono par dhyan deta hai; ismein poshan pakhwada, recipe tatha khady suraksha ke kaam bhi shaamil hain. Green Revolution paidavar badhane se, Mission Indradhanush teekakaran se tatha Clean India Mission safai se juda hai, isliye wo teeno alag hain. Exam point: shunya bhookh tatha khaane ki barbadi kam karne wala mission POSHAN 2.0 hai - yahi poshan tatha safai dono par dhyan deta hai.

qe: The 'SRESHTA' scheme is launched for which group of students?
qh: 'श्रेष्ठ' (SRESHTA) योजना किस समूह के छात्रों के लिए शुरू की गई है?
e: SRESHTA yojana anusuchit jaati ke nav-pratibhashali chhatraon ke liye shuru ki gayi hai; iske tehat kaksha nau tatha gyarah ke aise chhatra jo aage padhna chahte hain, unhe achhi quality wale residential school tatha hostel ki suvidha milti hai. Yah yojana isliye bani ki aise chhatra punji tatha achhi school na hone ke karan padhai chhod dete the, isliye yahi yojana unhe padhai tatha kaushal ke saath aage badhne ka pura mauka deti hai.Aadiwasi, alpasankhyak tatha chhatra ka varg is yojana ka hissa nahi hai; ismein anusuchit jaati ke pratibhashali chhatra hi aate hain. Exam point: SRESHTA yojana anusuchit jaati ke nav-pratibhashali chhatraon ke liye hai - yahi unhe achhi school tatha hostel ki suvidha deti hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide solar lighting and heating systems to 'Health and Wellness Centres'?
qh: 'स्वास्थ्य और कल्याण केंद्रों' को सौर प्रकाश और हीटिंग सिस्टम प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Solar for Health yojana ke tehat sarkari aspatalon tatha swasthya kendron ko saur urja se chalne wale bijli, roshni tatha heater lagane ke liye sahyog diya jaata hai. Yah soch isliye aai ki gaon ke aspatal mein bijli ka kat lagta rehta tha tatha zakhmi tatha prasav wali mahilaon ko andere tatha thand se jhujhna padta tha, isliye saur system se aspatal ki suvidhaen bina rukavat chalti hain tatha jeen-v-rakshak upkaran bhi salamat rehte hain.Aam saur mission, kisaan ke pump tatha sasti LED ke kaam alag hain, isliye swasthya kendron wali yojana inmein se koi nahi hai. Exam point: swasthya kendron ko saur roshni tatha heating dene wali yojana Solar for Health hai - yahi aspatal ki bijli ki rukavat door karti hai.

qe: What is the primary goal of the 'Vikasit Bharat Sankalp Yatra'?
qh: 'विकसित भारत संकल्प यात्रा' का प्राथमिक लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: Raising awareness and ensuring reach of govt schemes to all citizens
e: Vikasit Bharat Sankalp Yatra ka mukhya lakshya desh ke har kone tak sarkari yojanaon ki jankari dena tatha patra logon ko unse jodna hai; ismein sankalp rath, svayn sahayata samuh tatha panchayat ke zariye logon ko panjikaran tatha laabh dilaya jaata hai. Yah yatra isliye nikali ki kai patra log jankari ya paas nahi hone ke karan yojanaon ke laabh se vanchit reh jaate hain, isliye yahi abhiyan yojanaon ko gaon tatha shahar ki galiyon tak pahunchata hai. Paryatan badhawa, koi anya purpose ya tirth yatra lalch is yatra ka sahi uddeshya nahi hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Vikasit Bharat Sankalp Yatra ka lakshya yojanaon ki jankari dena tatha patra logon tak unka laabh pahunchana hai - yahi sankalp rath ke zariye har kone tak jaati hai.

qe: The 'PM-Janam' (Janman) mission is focused on which community?
qh: 'पीएम-जनमन' (PM-JANMAN) मिशन किस समुदाय पर केंद्रित है?
e: PM-JANMAN mission PVTG (Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups) samuday par kendra hai; yani desh ke sabse peeche reh gaye aadiwasi vargon ke ghar, saaf pani, sadak, bijli tatha aajeevika ki suvidhaon par yahi mission kaam karta hai. Yah dhyan isliye un par diya gaya ki aise samuday bahut chhote tatha bhugol se alag rahne ke karan school, aspatal tatha bazaar se door reh gaye the, isliye unhe mukhya dhara se jodne ke liye vishesh karyakram chala. Udyog majdoor, talab wale ya alpasankhyak yuva wale vikalp is mission ke sahi samuday nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PM-JANMAN mission PVTG samuday par kendra hai - yahi desh ke sabse peeche reh gaye aadiwasi vargon ki suvidhaon par kaam karta hai.

qe: What is the budget outlay for the 'PM Vishwakarma' scheme for five years?
qh: पांच वर्षों के लिए 'पीएम विश्वकर्मा' योजना का बजट परिव्यय क्या है?
e: PM Vishwakarma yojana ke liye paanch varsh ka kul budget paridhan 13,000 karod rupaye ka rakha gaya hai; is rakam se karigaron ko dhaar par bina gearan karz, prashikshan tatha tool kit jaisi suvidha di jaati hai. Yah rakam isliye itni bani ki is yojana ka daayra karod karigaron tatha unke parivar tak hai tatha unhe teen tarah ki madad ek saath chahiye, isliye sarkar ne lambe samay ka kosh tay kar diya. 5,000, 10,000 ya 20,000 karod wale aankde is yojana ke sahi budget nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PM Vishwakarma yojana ka paanch varsh ka budget 13,000 karod rupaye hai - yahi karigaron ko karz, prashikshan tatha tool deti hai.

qe: Which scheme provides insurance coverage to farmers against crop failure due to natural calamities?
qh: प्राकृतिक आपदाओं के कारण फसल बर्बाद होने पर किसानों को बीमा कवर कौन सी योजना प्रदान करती है?
e: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana ke tehat kharab mausam, keet, rog tatha praakritik aapda se fasal barbaad hone par kisaan ko beema ki bharpai milti hai; ismein kharif aur rabi faslon ke liye kisaan ka prem bahut kam tatha baki kharch sarkar uthaati hai. Yah beema isliye zaroori tha ki ek hi kharab mausam kisaan ka poora saal tatha uske karz ka bojh badha deta tha, isliye yahi suraksha use agli fasal bote tak zinda rakhti hai; nuksan ka aanklan sarkari sansthaen karti hain. PM-KMY pension, PM-KISAN sahayata tatha e-NAM bazaar wale vikalp is suraksha se alag hain, isliye wo sahi nahi hain. Exam point: praakritik aapda se fasal barbaad hone par beema PMFBY deti hai - ismein kisaan ka prem kam tatha sarkar ka hissa zyada hota hai.

qe: The 'Digital India Bhashini' mission is launched for which purpose?
qh: 'डिजिटल इंडिया भाषिणी' मिशन किस उद्देश्य के लिए शुरू किया गया है?
o: AI-based language translation in Indian languages
e: Digital India Bhashini mission ka lakshya bharat ki bhashaon mein AI ke zariye aapas mein anuvaad (translation) tatha awaaz ko text banane wali suvidha dena hai; yahi mission sarkari tatha niji sevaon ko har bhasha mein pahunchane ka zariya banata hai. Yah mission isliye shuru hua ki bharat mein sainkdon bhashaen bolne wale log daigital sevaon se kat jaate the, isliye yahi taknik kisaan, aspatal tatha adalat ki jankari unki bhasha mein pahunchaati hai; ismein khule srot (open source) modelon par kaam hota hai. Space taknik, school tak broadband tatha bhugtan ki suraksha anya vishay hain; inhe Bhashini mission ka uddeshya nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: Digital India Bhashini mission bharatiya bhashaon mein AI aadharit anuvaad ke liye hai - yahi sarkari sevaon ko har bhasha mein pahunchata hai.

qe: Under 'Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana' (PMMVY), the benefit is now extended to which child?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री मातृ वंदना योजना' (PMMVY) के तहत अब लाभ किस बच्चे तक बढ़ा दिया गया है?
o: First and second child (if second is a girl)
e: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana ka laabh ab doosre bachche tak bhi badha diya gaya hai; web prerna ke anusaar, doosri santan ke roop mein beti hone par yahi laabh milta hai tatha doosri santan ladka hone par nahi milta. Yah seema isliye badhayi gayi ki betiyon ke janm samay parivar par kharch tatha khana-peena achha rahe tatha maa ko poshan, teekakaran tatha jaanch ki suvidha mile; iska kharch kendra tatha rajya sarkaren uthaati hain.Sirf pehla bachcha, sabhi bachche tatha koi anya niyam yahan laagu nahi hai; doosra bachcha ladki hone par hi laabh milta hai. Exam point: PMMVY ka laabh ab pehle tatha doosre bachche (doosri beti hone par) tak badhaya gaya hai - yahi maa tatha bachche ki poshan madad deta hai.

qe: Which portal was launched to track 'Missing and Found Children'?
qh: 'लापता और पाए गए बच्चों' को ट्रैक करने के लिए कौन सा पोर्टल लॉन्च किया गया था?
e: Khoya-Paya tatha TrackChild dono portal lapata tatha paaye gaye bachchon ki jankari ek jagah laate hain tatha police, ghar tatha bachche ke punar-milan mein madad karte hain; isliye yahi dono jawab sahi hai. Yah vyavastha isliye bani ki bachche kho jaane par unke parivar ko jaldi jankari mile aur bachche ka istemal roka ja sake; portal par bachche ka vivaran tatha photo daal kar khojne wale tatha pahunchane wale dono pakshon ko joda jaata hai. Keval ek portal ja TrackChild wale vikalp is karyakram ka poora chitra nahi de paate, isliye sirf ek naam chunna sahi nahi hai. Exam point: lapata aur paaye gaye bachchon ki nigrani Khoya-Paya tatha TrackChild dono portal par hoti hai - yahi police tatha parivar ko jodte hain.

qe: What is the maximum amount of a 'Mudra Loan' under the 'Kishor' category?
qh: 'किशोर' श्रेणी के तहत 'मुद्रा ऋण' की अधिकतम राशि क्या है?
e: MUDRA yojana ki kishor shreni mein karz ki seema paanch lakh rupaye tak hai; shishu mein pachaas hazaar tak tatha tarun mein das lakh tak ka karz milta hai. Yah shreni isliye banayi gayi ki chhote tatha beech ke udyami apni zarurat tatha kshamata ke hisaab se sahi rakam le sakein tatha Pehle charan se aage badhne wale ka record bhi banta rahe; ismein karz bina gearan milta hai. Do lakh, pachaas hazaar tatha das lakh ke aankde doosri shreniyon ke hain, isliye kishor ke liye theek nahi baithte. Exam point: MUDRA yojana ki kishor shreni mein adhiktam karz 5 lakh rupaye milta hai - yahi tarun shreni se kam tatha shishu se zyada hai.

qe: The 'PM-KUSUM' scheme aims to achieve which energy target by 2026?
qh: 'पीएम-कुसुम' योजना 2026 तक किस ऊर्जा लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने का लक्ष्य रखती है?
e: PM-KUSUM yojana ka lakshya 2026 tak 34.8 GW saur urja lagana hai; ismein chhote saur plant, saur pump jaisi vibhinn ghataon ka jod shaamil hai. Yah lakshya isliye tay kiya gaya ki desh ki saur urja ki asli takat zameen tatha kisaanon ke kheton par saur panel lagane mein hai, isse kheti ki sinchai tatha bachi hui bijli bikar aay dono ka labh milta hai; iske tehat diesel pump bhi saur par badle jaate hain. 100 GW, 50 GW ya 10 GW wale aankde is yojana ke sahi lakshya nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PM-KUSUM ka lakshya 2026 tak 34.8 GW saur urja lagana hai - yahi kisaanon ki sinchai tatha aay badhata hai.

qe: Which scheme aims to provide support for the 'Rehabilitation of Transgender Persons'?
qh: 'ट्रांसजेंडर व्यक्तियों के पुनर्वास' के लिए सहायता प्रदान करने का लक्ष्य किस योजना का है?
e: SMILE yojana ke tehat transgender vyaktiyon ke punarvas, unke liye gunvatta wale ashrayagraha tatha unhe aajeevika se jodne ka kaam hota hai. Yah yojana isliye chali ki yahi varg samajik bhedbhao tatha ghar se doori ke karan bhikh tatha anya mushkilon mein reh jaata hai, isliye unke rahne tatha kamane ka intezaam karne se unki izzat tatha samman ke saath jeevan bita sakte hain; ismein prashikshan tatha aay ke sadhan bhi mile hain. HRIDAY dharohar, NAMASTE safai karmiyon tatha SRESHTA chhatraon se juda hai, isliye wo teeno alag hain. Exam point: transgender vyaktiyon ke punarvas ki yojana SMILE hai - yahi unhe rahne tatha aajeevika ka sahayak zariya deti hai.

qe: What is the insurance premium for 'Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana' (PMSBY) since June 2022?
qh: जून 2022 से 'प्रधानमंत्री सुरक्षा बीमा योजना' (PMSBY) का बीमा प्रीमियम क्या है?
e: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana ka premium June 2022 ke baad barhkar 20 rupaye salana ho gaya hai; sirf bees rupaye ke is halke kharch ke badle durghatna se mrutyu hone ya dono aankhein tatha dono pair chale jaane jaisi purn viklangata hone par do lakh rupaye tatha ek aankh ya ek pair jaisi adhi viklangata par ek lakh rupaye ka bhugtan milta hai. Yah prem badhane ki wajah yahi thi ki durghatna ke maamlon ka matara tatha aspatal ka kharch badha tha, par rakam barhane ke baad bhi yahi yojana desh ki sabse sasti durghatna beema maani jaati hai; bank khata se auto-debit hota hai.12, 436 tatha 100 rupaye anya yojanaon ke prem ke aankde hain, isliye PMSBY ke prem ka sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: PMSBY ka premium June 2022 se 20 rupaye salana hai - yahi 2 lakh rupaye tak ki durghatna suraksha deti hai.

qe: Which organization manages the 'PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi' portal?
qh: 'पीएम-किसान सम्मान निधि' पोर्टल का प्रबंधन कौन सा संगठन करता है?
e: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi portal ka prabandhan National Informatics Centre (NIC) karta hai; yahi sanstha portal ko sajati tatha is par samay-samay par kisaanon ke panjikaran tatha bhugtan ki jankari update karti hai. Yah zimma NIC ko dene ki wajah yahi thi ki is yojana se karod kisaan jude hain tatha unhe samay par aane wale laabh ki jankari dena tatha nakli panjikaran hatana zaroori tha; iske aadhaar, bhoomi record tatha bank khate ka milaan hota hai. RBI, NITI Aayog ya Grih Mantralaya is portal ke sahi prabandhak nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi portal ka prabandhan NIC karta hai - yahi panjikaran tatha bhugtan ki jankari ko sahi rakhta hai.

qe: The 'YUVA 2.0' scheme is an initiative to train which group?
qh: 'YUVA 2.0' योजना किस समूह को प्रशिक्षित करने की एक पहल है?
e: YUVA 2.0 yojana ka sambandh yuva lekhakon (young authors) ko prashikshan tatha manch dene se hai; iske tehat chuni hui sanskritik tatha bhasha ke baare mein likhne wale yuvaon ko grant tatha mentoring milti hai. Yah pahal isliye shuru ki gayi ki bharat ki bhashaon mein naye lekhak kam aage aa rahe the, isliye unhe shuru se hi rachna tatha prakashan ki samajh di jaati hai; iska ek anya roop yuva lekhakon ke liye kaam karta hai.Bekar doctor, naye udyami tatha khiladi ka varg is yojana mein nahi hai; yahan lekhak banne wale yuva chune jaate hain. Exam point: YUVA 2.0 yojana yuva lekhakon ko prashikshan dene ki pahal hai - yahi bharatiya bhashaon mein naye lekhak tayar karti hai.

qe: What is the purpose of the 'PRAN' number under 'Atal Pension Yojana' (APY)?
qh: 'अटल पेंशन योजना' (APY) के तहत 'PRAN' नंबर का उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: PRAN number ya Permanent Retirement Account Number NPS ke tehat har sadasya ko diya jaane wala ek vishesh 12 ank ka pehchaan praman hota hai; yahi uski poore desh mein ek hi pension khate ki pehchaan hoti hai. Yah number isliye banaya gaya ki sadasya ka pura record naukri badalne tatha jagah badalne par bhi ek hi jagah juda rahe, isliye pension ke nakad tatha annuity ke hisse ka hisaab isi ke zariye hota hai. Pension Recovery Act, Property Registration ya koi anya kaam is number ka uddeshya nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: PRAN number Permanent Retirement Account Number ka chhota roop hai - yahi NPS ke sadasya ki pehchaan hoti hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched for the 'Interlinking of Rivers' starting with Ken-Betwa?
qh: केन-बेतवा से शुरू होने वाली 'नदियों को जोड़ने' के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Rashtriya Nadi Jodne ki Yojana (National River Interlinking Project) ke tehat Ken tatha Betwa nadiyon ko jodne ka kaam shuru hua; iske alawa Godavari-Krishna tatha Ken-Betwa link jaisi pariyojnaon par bhi kaam ho raha hai. Yah yojana isliye sochi gayi ki ek taraf badh wale kshetra ka pani bekaar bah jaata hai tatha doosri taraf sookhe kshetra ki kheti tatha peene ka pani khatam hota hai, isliye pani ko nadi ke zariye bhejne se dono kshetra ki madad hoti hai; par ispar paryavaran tatha jungle ke sawal bhi uthte hain. Bharat Jodo yatra alag andolan tha, Jal Shakti Mission paani sanrakshan tatha Namami Gange nadi ki safai se juda hai, isliye wo alag hain. Exam point: Ken-Betwa se shuru hone wali nadiyon ko jodne ki yojana National River Interlinking Project hai - yahi ek kshetra ka atirikt pani doosre tak bhejti hai.

qe: The 'PM-SVANidhi' scheme is currently extended up to which year?
qh: 'पीएम-स्वानिधि' योजना को वर्तमान में किस वर्ष तक बढ़ा दिया गया है?
e: PM SVANidhi yojana ko 2024 tak badhaya gaya tha; yani is yojana ke tehat talab walon ko karz tatha anya suvidhaen is avadhi tak milti rahengi. Yah vistar isliye kiya gaya ki mahamari ke baad bhi talab walon ka karobar poora nahi sudhra tatha unhe karz chukane tatha aage badhne ka samay chahiye tha; samay par chukane par unhe agla bada karz tatha daigital bhugtan par cashback jaisa labh bhi milta hai. 2023, 2025 ya 2026 wale vikalp is yojana ke sahi vistar varsh nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PM SVANidhi yojana ko 2024 tak badhaya gaya - yahi talab walon ko karz tatha cashback ka laabh deti hai.

qe: What is the interest rate subsidy under the 'PM-Vishwakarma' scheme for loans?
qh: ऋण के लिए 'पीएम-विश्वकर्मा' योजना के तहत ब्याज दर सब्सिडी क्या है?
e: PM Vishwakarma yojana ke tehat karigaron ko diye jaane wale karz par byaj dar ki subsidy 5 pratishat tay ki gayi hai; yani sarkar karz ki lagat ka bada hissa khud uthaati hai tatha karigar ko kam byaj par rakam milti hai. Yah sahara isliye diya jaata hai ki karigar ka munafa patla hota hai tatha uchch byaj uski kamai kha jaati hai, isliye yahi subsidy unhe naye auzaar tatha bade kaam mein madad karti hai; iske saath tool kit ki rakam grant ke roop mein milti hai. Aath tatha teen pratishat ke aankde kisi anya suvidha ke hain; paanch pratishat hi is subsidy ka sahi daam hai. Exam point: PM Vishwakarma yojana mein karigar ko karz par 5 pratishat byaj subsidy milti hai - yahi karigar ko kam byaj par karz dilati hai.

qe: Which mission focuses on reducing 'Neonatal Mortality' in India?
qh: भारत में 'नवजात मृत्यु दर' को कम करने पर कौन सा मिशन केंद्रित है?
e: Janani Suraksha Yojana ka dhyan prasav ke samay maa tatha naye bachche ki suraksha par hai; iske tehat sanstha (aspatal) mein prasav karane par nakad sahayata tatha free jaanch, dawa tatha bachche ke teekakaran jaisi suvidha milti hai. Yah yojana isliye shuru hui thi ki gaon mein ghar par prasav karane se maa tatha naye bachche ki maut ka khatra bahut zyada hota tha, isliye aspatal mein prasav karaya jaane se navjat shishu ki maut tatha kam wazan dikkat dono ghati. Mission Indradhanush teekakaran, POSHAN Abhiyaan poshan tatha SAANS naye bachche ki saans ki suvidha se juda hai, isliye wo teeno alag hain. Exam point: navjat mrityu dar kam karne par Janani Suraksha Yojana ka dhyan hai - yahi aspatal mein prasav tatha bachche ki dekh-rekh ko badhava deti hai.

qe: The 'National Beekeeping and Honey Mission' (NBHM) is under which ministry?
qh: 'राष्ट्रीय मधुमक्खी पालन और शहद मिशन' (NBHM) किस मंत्रालय के अंतर्गत है?
e: Rashtriya Madhumakkhi Palan tatha Shahad Mission (NBHM) Krishi Mantralaya ke adheen hai; ismein madhumakkhi palan, shahad utpadan tatha madhumakkhiyon ke sanrakshan ke liye kisaanon tatha udyamiyon ko madad di jaati hai. Yah mission isliye zaroori hai ki madhumakkhi parag (pollination) ka kaam karke fasal ka paidavar badhati hai tatha shahad se alag aay deti hai, isliye yahi yojana kheti tatha paryavaran dono ka bhala karti hai; ismein prashikshan tatha behtar dabbe bhi diye jaate hain. Vanijya, MSME ya Grameen Vikas mantralaya wale vikalp is mission ke sahi mantralaya nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: NBHM Krishi Mantralaya ke adheen hai - yahi madhumakkhi palan tatha shahad utpadan ko badhava deta hai.

qe: What is the maximum limit of an annual premium for 'PMJJBY' as of 2024?
qh: 2024 तक 'PMJJBY' के लिए वार्षिक प्रीमियम की अधिकतम सीमा क्या है?
e: PMJJBY ka varshik premium 2024 tak 436 rupaye hi raha hai; is rakam ka bhugtan bank khate se auto-debit hota hai tatha iske badle mrutyu hone par do lakh rupaye ki beema suraksha chhat milti hai. Yah prem isliye itna halka rakha gaya ki gaon tatha shahar ka har kaam karne wala vyakti ise kharch ke bojh ke bina bhugtan kar sake; asli arth mein yahi yojana garib parivar ke mukhiya ki achanak mrityu par unhe sahara deti hai. 500, 330 ya 1,000 wale aankde is yojana ke sahi prem nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PMJJBY ka varshik premium 436 rupaye hai - yahi 2 lakh ka jeevan beema cover deta hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to improve 'Energy Efficiency' in industries?
qh: उद्योगों में 'ऊर्जा दक्षता' सुधारने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: PAT yani Perform, Achieve and Trade yojana bade udyogon mein urja dakhshta (energy efficiency) sudharne ke liye shuru ki gayi thi; ismein tay seema se kam bijli kharch karne wale udyog ko bachayi hui urja ke praman patra milte hain jo wo doosron ko bech sakte hain. Yah tarika isliye apnaya gaya ki ispat, siment tatha anya bhaari udyogon ka bijli kharch sabse zyada hai, isliye ek hi jaisa lakshya tay karne se bade paimane par bijli tatha koyle ki bachat hoti hai. UJALA sasti LED, SAUBHAGYA ghar tak bijli tatha KUSUM wali saur pump yojana se juda hai, isliye wo alag hain. Exam point: udyogon mein urja dakhshta ke liye PAT yojana chalti hai - yahi bachayi hui urja ke praman patra deti hai.

qe: The 'PM-Daksh' portal is meant for which group?
qh: 'पीएम-दक्ष' (PM-Daksh) पोर्टल किस समूह के लिए है?
o: Skill development of SC, OBC and Safai Karamcharis
e: PM-Daksh portal SC, OBC tatha Safai Karamchariyon ke kaushal vikas ke liye hai; iske tehat in vargon ke yuvaon ko rozgar tatha svayn-rozgar ke liye short term tatha long term prashikshan diya jaata hai tatha prashikshan ke baad unhe job mela tatha karz se bhi joda jaata hai. Yah portal isliye bana ki in samuhon ka prashikshan tatha behtar naukri tak pahunch kam thi, isliye yahi prashikshan se unh di aay badhane ka zariya banta hai; ismein mahilaon tatha bade-buzurgon ke liye alag course hote hain. Kisaan, yuva lekhak tatha doctor ka varg yahan nahi aata; is portal ka daayra kaushal vikas ki zarurat wale vargon tak hai. Exam point: PM-Daksh portal SC, OBC tatha Safai Karamchariyon ke kaushal vikas ke liye hai - yahi unhe prashikshan tatha rozgar se jodta hai.

qe: What is the target number of 'Aspirational Blocks' identified under the Aspirational Blocks Programme?
qh: आकांक्षी ब्लॉक कार्यक्रम के तहत पहचाने गए 'आकांक्षी ब्लॉकों' की लक्ष्य संख्या क्या है?
e: Aakanshi Block Programme ke tehat desh ke 500 akanshi blocks chune gaye the; yahi blocks khadi vikas ke aise soochak (indicator) mein sabse peeche the jinhe sudharna aasaan tatha labhdayak tha. Yah chunav isliye kiya gaya ki jilaon ke andar bhi kuchh blocks bahut kam vikas paye, isliye unhe alag se chun kar soochak tay karke tatha samuhik pratispardha (competition) se tezi se sudharna aasaan hota hai; NITI Aayog iski nigrani karta hai. 1000, 100 ya 2000 wale aankde is programme ke sahi aankde nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: Aakanshi Block Programme mein 500 akanshi blocks chune gaye - yahi sabse peeche reh gaye blocks ko tez vikas ke raste par laata hai.

qe: Which mission aims to double the 'Income of Farmers' through various interventions?
qh: किस मिशन का लक्ष्य विभिन्न हस्तक्षेपों के माध्यम से 'किसानों की आय' को दोगुना करना है?
o: None (It's a combined goal across schemes)
Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture
e: Kisaanon ki aay doguna karne ka lakshya kisi ek yojana ka nahi balki kai yojanaon ke milkar kaam ka parinam hai; ise 2022 tak poora karne ka lakshya rakha gaya tha tatha iske liye fasal paidavar, dairy, machhli palan tatha kheti ke atirikt kamai par dhyan diya jaata tha. Yah soch isliye banayi gayi ki sirf anaaj ki paidavar badhane se kisaan ki jeb nahi bharti, isliye uski lagat ghatane, sahi daam dilane tatha atirikt dhandon se aay badhane ka manch tayar kiya gaya. Blue Revolution machhli palan, Operation Green sabzi-fal par tatha Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture bageechi kheti par keval alag-alag kshetra mein kaam karte hain, isliye koi ek unmein se is lakshya ka poora naam nahi hai. Exam point: kisaanon ki aay doguna karna kai yojanaon ka saajha lakshya hai - yahi anaaj ke atirikt dairy tatha anya dhandon se aay badhane par kaam karta hai.

qe: The 'E-Sanjeevani' portal provides which type of service?
qh: 'ई-संजीवनी' पोर्टल किस प्रकार की सेवा प्रदान करता है?
e: E-Sanjeevani portal door-baithi ilaj (tele-consultation) tatha online OPD ki suvidha deta hai, jismein mareez ghar se hi mobile ya computer par doctor se baat karke salah tatha nuskha le sakta hai. Iska prabandhan rashtriya swasthya mission sambhalta hai tatha yahi portal Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission se juda hua hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki gaon tatha dur-daraz ilaakon mein visheshagya doctoron ki kami rehti hai, isliye online OPD se bina safar tatha bheed ke salah milti hai tatha doosri raay (second opinion) lena bhi aasan ho jaata hai. Swasthya beema dilana, khoon daan karna tatha paudhe kharidna is portal ka kaam nahi hai, isliye ye teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: E-Sanjeevani door-baithi salah tatha online OPD ki suvidha deta hai - yahi gaon tak doctor ki pahunch aasan banata hai.

qe: Under 'Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana', what is the minimum annual deposit required?
qh: 'सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना' के तहत न्यूनतम वार्षिक जमा राशि क्या है?
e: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana mein beti ke naam par khata kholne ke liye sabse kam 250 rupaye saalana jama karne padte hain; ek saal mein 1.5 lakh rupaye tak jama kiya ja sakta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki yojana ka maksad chhote shehron tatha gaon ke seemit aay wale parivaron ko bhi jodna hai, isliye jama ki sabse kam seema bahut chhoti rakhi gayi hai; khata das varsh ki aayu ke baad khulta hai tatha jama pandrah saal tak chalta hai, phir byaj ke saath rakam badhti rehti hai. 500, 1,000 tatha 2,000 rupaye ki rakmein is kam se kam shart se alag hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Sukanya Samriddhi khate mein sabse kam 250 rupaye saalana jama hota hai - yahi chhoti si bachat ko badi raashi banane ka rasta kholta hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide 'Solar Water Heaters' in urban areas?
qh: शहरी क्षेत्रों में 'सोलर वाटर हीटर' प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Shehron ke gharo tatha sansthaon mein saur urja se paani garam karne wale yantra lagane ke liye Rashtriya Saur Mission (JNNSM) ke tehat madad milti hai; yahi mission 2010 mein shuru hua tatha aage chalkar iska kaam Solar Energy Corporation of India sambhalti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki geyser bijli khapat ka bada hissa hota hai, isliye sooraj ki ushma se paani garam karne par har mahine ka bijli bill ghat jaata hai tatha carbon utsarga kam hota hai. Solar City Mission shehron ko saur banane ka vichar hai, AMRUT mein nal-jal tatha sewer ki baatein hoti hain tatha PM-Awas makaan banane ki yojana hai, isliye ye teenon theek nahi hain. Exam point: saur paani garam karne wale yantra JNNSM ke tehat lagte hain - yahi saur urja ko shehri kharach ghatane ka zariya banata hai.

qe: The 'PRASAD' scheme was renamed as which of the following?
qh: 'प्रसाद' (PRASAD) योजना का नाम बदलकर निम्नलिखित में से क्या कर दिया गया है?
e: PRASAD yani Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Augmentation Drive yojana teerth sthalon ke vikas ke liye shuru hui thi tatha aage ise badhakar naya naam PRASHAD diya gaya. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki teerth yatrion ki sankhya lagatar badh rahi thi, isliye yojana ka naam badalkar uske bade daayre ko dikhaya gaya tatha naam mein H jodkar naya roop diya gaya. HRIDAY yojana dharohar wale shehron ke vikas ke liye alag mission hai, Pilgrimage Heritage kisi yojana ka naam nahi hai tatha None of these kathan yahan theek nahi baithta, kyunki sahi naam PRASHAD hi hai. Exam point: PRASAD yojana ka naya naam PRASHAD hai - yahi teerth sthalon ko suvidha tatha dharohar ke vikas se jodta hai.

qe: What is the primary target of the 'PM-Kisan Maandhan Yojana'?
qh: 'पीएम-किसान मानधन योजना' का प्राथमिक लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: Old age pension for small and marginal farmers
e: PM-Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY) ka mukhya lakshya chhote tatha seemant kisaanon ko budhape ki pension pahunchana hai; 18 se 40 varsh ke aise kisaan ismein jud sakte hain jinki aay ki seema tay hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki chhote kisaan ke paas bachat ka koi bharosemand tarika nahi hota, isliye sarkar uske chhote yogdan ke saath apna hissa jod deti hai tatha saath varsh ki aayu ke baad ushe har mahine teen hazaar rupaye pahunchti hain. Fasal beema, saur pump lagana tatha muft beej baantna is yojana ka kaam nahi hai, isliye ye teeno sahi vikalp nahi hain. Exam point: PM-KMY ka maksad gaon ke chhote kisan ki budhape ki fikr door karna hai - yahi unki chhoti jama par sarkar ka hissa jodkar pakka bhugtan deta hai.

qe: Which scheme aims to provide high-speed broadband to all villages through 'Optical Fibre' by 2025?
qh: 2025 तक 'ऑप्टिकल फाइबर' के माध्यम से सभी गांवों को हाई-स्पीड ब्रॉडबैंड प्रदान करने का लक्ष्य किस योजना का है?
e: Gaon tak optical fibre (OFC) bichhakar sabhi gram panchayat ko tez rafatr (high-speed) broadband dene ka lakshya BharatNet ka hai tatha ise 2025 tak poora karne ki yojana hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki fibre optic cable mein jankari roshni ke roop mein bahut tez chalti hai, isliye isse online padhai, sarkari sevaen tatha digital bhugtan gaon tak pahunchte hain. PM-WANI chhote dukano par public wifi hotspot ka vichar hai, Digital India poore desh ka chhatri karyakram hai tatha GramNet kisi sarkari yojana ka naam nahi hai, isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: villages tak optical fibre se tez broadband BharatNet deta hai - yahi gram panchayaton ko digital sevaon se jodta hai.

qe: The 'Lakhpati Didi' scheme aims to empower how many women through Self-Help Groups (SHGs)?
qh: 'लखपति दीदी' योजना का लक्ष्य स्वयं सहायता समूहों (SHGs) के माध्यम से कितनी महिलाओं को सशक्त बनाना है?
e: Lakhpati Didi yojana ka maksad svayn sahayata samuhon (SHGs) ki teen karod mahilaon ko aisi kamai wali banana hai jo saal bhar mein ek lakh se adhik ho jaaye; ise 2023-24 mein aur zor diya gaya. Iska mukhya kaaran yahi hai ki samuh se judi mahila ko karz, prashikshan tatha bazaar milta hai, isliye wo doodh, murgi-palan, silai tatha chhote udyog se apni aay badha kar lakhpati ban sakti hai. Beti Bachao Beti Padhao ladkiyon ki padhai ka abhiyan hai, Matru Vandana Yojana garbhvati mahilaon ko sahayata deta hai tatha Stand-Up India badi rakam ka karz deta hai, isliye teenon galat chunav hain. Exam point: Lakhpati Didi yojana ka nishana samuh ki mahilaon ki saalana aay ko lakh ke paar le jaana hai - yahi mahila sashaktikaran ka seedha rasta hai.

qe: Which mission focuses on the elimination of 'Sickle Cell Anemia' in India by 2047?
qh: किस मिशन का लक्ष्य 2047 तक भारत में 'सिकल सेल एनीमिया' को खत्म करना है?
o: National Sickle Cell Anemia Elimination Mission
e: Sickle Cell Anemia ko poori tarah khatam karne ke liye 2047 tak ka lakshya rakhne wala mission National Sickle Cell Anemia Elimination Mission hai, jise 2023 mein janjatiya kshetron ko dhyan mein rakhkar shuru kiya gaya. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki yah bimari khoon ki vanshagat (genetic) hoti hai tatha janjatiya samudayon mein iska asar zyada milta hai, isliye saat karod logon ki jaanch tatha lakshan wale mareezon ki salah is mission ka mukhya kaam hai. Poshan Abhiyaan khaane-paani tatha kuposhan dekhta hai, Mission Indradhanush teekakaran chalata hai tatha Ayushman Bharat ilaj ka kharch uthaata hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Sickle Cell Anemia ko 2047 tak khatam karne ka mission National Sickle Cell Anemia Elimination Mission hai - yahi janjatiya kshetron mein jaanch tatha salah par zor deta hai.

qe: What is the maximum limit for a 'Tarun' category loan under MUDRA Yojana?
qh: मुद्रा योजना के तहत 'तरुण' श्रेणी के ऋण की अधिकतम सीमा क्या है?
e: MUDRA yojana ki tarun shreni mein karz ki adhiktam seema das lakh rupaye hai; isse upar ki shreni tarun-plus kehlati hai tatha das lakh se adhik karz usmein aata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki jis udyami ka kaam badh chuka hota hai use zyada punji chahiye hoti hai, isliye shreniyaan kharch ki zarurat ke hisaab se banti hain; pachaas hazaar tak ka karz shishu shreni mein aata hai. Bees lakh tatha paanch lakh ki seemayein kisi doosri shreni ki shart nahi hain tatha pachaas hazaar to shishu ki seema hai, isliye ise sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: MUDRA ki tarun shreni mein das lakh rupaye tak ka karz milta hai - yahi beech ke chhote udyami ko badhne mein madad deti hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide 'Drone' training to women in rural areas for agriculture?
qh: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में महिलाओं को कृषि के लिए 'ड्रोन' प्रशिक्षण प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Gaon ki mahilaon ko drone chalane ka prashikshan tatha kheti mein spray (dawa tatha khaad) ka kaam saunpne ke liye Namo Drone Didi yojana shuru ki gayi hai, jismein drone kharidne par vitti madad bhi milti hai. Iska mukhya kaaran yahi hai ki samuh ki mahila ko pehle yahi kaam apne kharch par karna padta tha, ab drone se spray tezi se tatha barabar matra mein hota hai tatha mahila ko alag se aay bhi milti hai. Lakhpati Didi mahilaon ko karobar se jodti hai par drone udane ki taknik usmein nahi hai, saur pump ka kaam bijli se hai tatha Drone Shakti naam ki koi yojana muddon mein nahi hai, isliye wo teenon galat chunav hain. Exam point: kheti mein chhidkav karne ke liye mahilaon ko drone chalana Namo Drone Didi yojana sikhhati hai - yahi samuh ki mahilaon ki kamai ka naya zariya hai.

qe: The 'PM-Vidyalaxmi' scheme provides what type of support to students?
qh: 'पीएम-विद्यालक्ष्मी' योजना छात्रों को किस प्रकार की सहायता प्रदान करती है?
o: Education Loans and Scholarships through a single window
e: PM-Vidyalaxmi yojana uchch shiksha ke chhatraon ko ek hi khidki se karz tatha chhatravritti deti hai tatha ismein CSIS tatha anya portal jud gaye hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki karz tatha vajifa ke liye alag-alag daftar tatha kayi aavedan chalte the, isliye ek portal par aavedan, praman tatha byaj ki sahayata (interest subvention) dene se chhatra ko bhatakna nahi padta. Muft vardi, mid-day meal tatha muft coaching school star ke karyakram hain, isliye inhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: PM-Vidyalaxmi uchch shiksha ke liye shiksha karz tatha chhatravritti ek hi portal se deti hai - yahi padhai ka kharch aasan banati hai.

qe: What is the primary goal of 'Mission Amrit Sarovar'?
qh: 'मिशन अमृत सरोवर' का प्राथमिक लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: Rejuvenating 75 water bodies in each district
e: Har zile mein 75 jal kundon ko saaf tatha jeevit karke lok-sahbhagiti se jal sanrakshan ka kaam Mission Amrit Sarovar karta hai; ise Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav se joda gaya. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki gaon ke talab tatha pokhar sookh gaye the tatha barish ka paani bekaar beh jaata tha, isliye unhe dobara khodkar bharne se bhu-jal (ground water) barhta hai tatha gaon ko paani milta hai. Deep sea mining tatha nadiyon ka jodna anya missionon ka kaam hai tatha Ganga ki safai Namami Gange ke tehat hoti hai, isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: Mission Amrit Sarovar har zile mein 75 jal sthal ko dobara jeevit karta hai - yahi sookhe talabon ko bhar kar gaon ki paani ki zarurat poori karta hai.

qe: Which scheme ensures 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in rural areas?
qh: कौन सी योजना ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में 100 दिनों के गारंटीकृत मजदूरी रोजगार सुनिश्चित करती है?
e: Gaon ke kshetron mein ek varsh mein kam se kam sau din ki pakki mazdoori dene wala kanoon MGNREGA hai, jismein kaam na de paane par bhatta dena padta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki kheti tatha mausam par nirbhar mazdooron ko saal bhar kaam nahi milta, isliye yahi yojana unhe nali khodne, talab, sadak tatha paudharopan jaisa rozgar deti hai. PMAY-G mehngai ka makan banane ki yojana hai, NRLM aajeevika mission ke samuh chalati hai tatha PMGSY sadak banati hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: MGNREGA Gramin Rozgar Guarantee ka kanoon hai - yahi gaon ke parivar ko saal mein sau din kaam tatha bhatta pakka karta hai.

qe: The 'PM-JANMAN' mission is focused on which group?
qh: 'पीएम-जनमन' (PM-JANMAN) मिशन किस समूह पर केंद्रित है?
e: PM-JANMAN mission vishesh roop se kamzor janjatiya samuhon (PVTG) ke vikas ke liye shuru kiya gaya hai, jismein unhe pakke ghar, sadak tatha saaf paani jaise lakshya jode jaate hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ye samuh sheher tatha gaon se alag-alag van tatha pahadi ilaakon mein rehta hai tatha inki aabadi bahut kam hoti hai, isliye aam yojanaon ke faayde un tak theek se nahi pahunchte. Udyog mazdoor, shehri gareeb tatha sharnarthi is mission ka daayra nahi hain, isliye inhe is mission ka hissa nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: PM-JANMAN mission PVTG ke vikas ke liye hai - yahi sabse kamzor janjatiya samuh ko mukhya dhara se jodta hai.

qe: What is the maximum age to join the 'Atal Pension Yojana'?
qh: 'अटल पेंशन योजना' में शामिल होने की अधिकतम आयु क्या है?
e: Atal Pension Yojana mein jude jaane ke liye adhiktam aayu chalis varsh hai; isse badi aayu wale log is kosh mein nahi aa sakte. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki pension ka kosh lambi jama maangta hai, isliye jaldi judne par har mahine ka yogdan chhota rehta hai tatha pandrah-se-bees saal ki jama se budhape ka bhugtan pakka ho jaata hai. Pachaas, tees tatha saath varsh ki seema chalis se alag hai tatha das varsh ki shart kisi anya yojana ki hai, isliye ise sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: APY mein adhiktam pravesh aayu 40 varsh hai - yahi kosh ko lambi jama se mazboot banati hai.

qe: Which scheme provides an annual health cover of Rs. 5 Lakh per family?
qh: कौन सी योजना प्रति परिवार 5 लाख रुपये का वार्षिक स्वास्थ्य कवर प्रदान करती है?
e: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) patra parivaron ko saalana paanch lakh rupaye tak ka muft ilaaj deti hai tatha iske tehat aspatal mein bharti hone par cash dena nahi padta. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ek bade aspatal ka kharch gareeb parivar ki saalana kamai se bhi adhik ho jaata hai, isliye yahi suraksha unhe garibi ki seema par rahne se bachaati hai. Mission Indradhanush teeke lagata hai, PMJJBY mrityu ki beema hai tatha PMSBY durnaghtna ki beema hai, isliye ye teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: saalana paanch lakh ka muft ilaaj Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) deti hai - yahi aspatal ke kharch ka bojh parivar se hataati hai.

qe: The 'SVAMITVA' scheme uses which technology for mapping rural lands?
qh: 'स्वामित्व' योजना ग्रामीण भूमि के मानचित्रण के लिए किस तकनीक का उपयोग करती है?
e: SVAMITVA yojana gaon ke aabadi (basted) ilaake ki nakshebandi drone ki madad se karati hai tatha ise Survey of India chalata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki drone se hawa se tez tasveerein banti hain tatha GPS se seema ka nishaan lagta hai, isliye zameen ka pramaan patra aasaani se ban jaata hai; phir yahi pramaan patra (property card) bank ke karz ke liye bhi chalta hai. Manual survey waqt lega tatha satellite tatha Lidar bhi is kaam mein alag tarah se lagte hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: SVAMITVA gaon ki zameen ka nakshe drone ki madad se banati hai - yahi gharelu sampatti ke pramaan ko pakka karti hai.

qe: Which portal was launched to create a national database of 'Unorganized Workers'?
qh: 'असंगठित श्रमिकों' का राष्ट्रीय डेटाबेस बनाने के लिए कौन सा पोर्टल लॉन्च किया गया था?
e: Asangathit mazdooron ka rashtriya database tayar karne ke liye e-Shram portal banaya gaya hai, jismein nirmaan mazdoor, gharelu kaamkaji, rikshaw chalane wale tatha khet mazdoor jaisi shram shakti judi hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki aise kaamkaji ke paas pakka rozgar tatha samajik suraksha ka koi kagaz nahi hota, isliye pehchan patra milne par unhe anya yojanaon ka faayda bhi aasaani se milta hai. Aatmanirbhar portal, Udyam portal tatha Shram Suvidha alag kaam karte hain, isliye inhe theek nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: asangathit shramikon ka data e-Shram portal par hota hai - yahi unhe samajik suraksha ki dhara se jodta hai.

qe: What is the premium for 'Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana' (PMSBY) per annum?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री सुरक्षा बीमा योजना' (PMSBY) का प्रति वर्ष प्रीमियम क्या है?
e: PMSBY wali durnaghtna beema ka saalana shulk bees rupaye tay hai; yah rakam jude hue bank khate se khud kat jaati hai. Yah vyavastha isliye banti hai ki chhoti jeb wale majdoor bhi beema ki seema mein aa sakein, kyunki itna halka kharch parivar par bhaari nahi padta, par durnaghtna mein jaan chali jaane par do lakh rupaye ka sahara mil jaata hai. 436 rupaye PMJJBY ke jeevan beema ka prem hai tatha 12 tatha 100 ke aankde kisi anya suvidha ke hain, isliye ise sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: PMSBY ke liye ek saal ka bees rupaye ka shulk hi kaafi hai - isi chhoti rakam par do lakh rupaye tak ka bhugtan milta hai.

qe: Under the 'Ujjwala 2.0' scheme, what additional benefit is provided to beneficiaries?
qh: 'उज्ज्वला 2.0' योजना के तहत लाभार्थियों को क्या अतिरिक्त लाभ दिया जाता है?
e: Ujjwala 2.0 mein labharthi ko muft gas connection ke saath pehla refill tatha chulha bhi muft milta hai tatha khud hi pata likhkar kagaz ka kaam ho jaata hai, isliye teenon baatein sahi hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki pehli Ujjwala yojana aise parivaron tak nahi pahunch payi thi jinke paas chulha tatha pehla refill ka kharch nahi tha, isliye 2.0 mein yahi do rukavatein hata di gayi. Muft chulha ya muft refill mein se koi ek kehna adhura hai tatha khud-praman ki suvidha bhi isi yojana ka hissa hai, isliye ise sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: Ujjwala 2.0 mein muft chulha, pehla muft refill tatha khud-praman teenon milte hain - yahi gareeb parivar ko dhuen se bachata hai.

qe: Which scheme focuses on providing solar-powered lamps to students in rural areas?
qh: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों के छात्रों को सौर ऊर्जा से चलने वाले लैंप प्रदान करने पर कौन सी योजना केंद्रित है?
e: Gaon ke aise chhatraon ko padhne ke liye saur urja se chalne wala lamp dene ka kaam Solar Study Lamp Scheme karta hai; yahi is kaam ki sahi yojana hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki jahan bijli nahi pahunchti wahan raat ki padhai ruk jaati hai, isliye lamp milne par bachche bina mehange kharch ke roshni pa lete hain tatha tel se chalne wale diye bhi hata jaate hain. UJALA sasti LED bulb baantti hai, SAUBHAGYA gharon tak bijli pahunchaata hai tatha PM-KUSUM kisaan ke pump par kaam karta hai, isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: Solar Study Lamp Scheme ke tehat chhatraon ko sooraj ki urja se chalne wala lamp milta hai - yahi andhere gaon mein padhai ko roshni deta hai.

qe: The 'PM-DevINE' scheme is specifically for which part of India?
qh: 'PM-DevINE' योजना विशेष रूप से भारत के किस भाग के लिए है?
e: PM-DevINE yojana vishesh roop se poore uttar-poorv kshetra ke vikas ke liye 2022-23 ke budget mein shuru ki gayi thi. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki pahadi tatha seemavarti ilaake hone ke karan wahan bade karkhane tatha sadak ki zarurat adhik hoti hai, isliye is yojana se wahan ke yuvaon ke liye aajeevika tatha basic dhaancha ke kaam bante hain. Ladakh, tatiya kshetra tatha aakanshi zile alag-alag karyakram dekhte hain, isliye unhe is yojana ka roop nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: PM-DevINE yojana poorvottar ke rajyaon ke liye hai - yahi wahan ke yuvaon ke liye aajeevika tatha dhaancha banati hai.

qe: What does 'F' stand for in the 'PM-FME' scheme?
qh: 'PM-FME' योजना में 'F' का क्या अर्थ है?
e: PM-FME mein F ka matlab Formalisation hai, yani PM Formalisation of Micro food Processing Enterprises yojana chhote khadyan udyog ko rasmi daayre mein laati hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ghar par aachaar tatha papad banane wale ko licence, kagaz tatha bazaar ki jaankari nahi hoti, isliye unhe pehchan, karz tatha mukhya dhara dilaana zaroori hota hai. Food, Finance tatha Farmers wale vikalp poora naam nahi banate, kyunki asli naam mein micro food processing enterprises tatha formalisation shabd aate hain. Exam point: PM-FME mein F se Formalisation hai - yahi chhote khadyan udyog ko rasmi daayre mein aane ki taraf le jaata hai.

qe: The 'Stand-Up India' scheme provides loans to which categories of entrepreneurs?
qh: 'स्टैंड-अप इंडिया' योजना किन श्रेणियों के उद्यमियों को ऋण प्रदान करती है?
e: Stand-Up India ka daayra anusuchit jaati tatha janjati tatha mahila udyamiyon tak hai tatha inhe das lakh se ek crore rupaye tak ka bank karz milta hai; ek parivar se ek hi vyakti karz le sakta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki in vargon ko bade bank karz ke liye zameen, praman tatha bharosa milna mushkil hota hai, isliye yahi yojana unhe apna karkhana ya dukaan shuru karne ka mauka deti hai. Berojgar yuva, sevaniwrit sainik tatha saamanya purush wale vikalp yojana ke tay daayre se alag hain, isliye inmein se koi sahi nahi hai. Exam point: Stand-Up India ka daayra SC/ST tatha mahila udyamiyon tak hai - yahi unhe bade karz ke liye bharosa dilaati hai.

qe: Which mission aims to double India's 'Fisheries' export by 2024-25?
qh: किस मिशन का लक्ष्य 2024-25 तक भारत के 'मत्स्य' निर्यात को दोगुना करना है?
e: Machhali (fisheries) ke niryat ko 2024-25 tak doguna karne ka lakshya Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) ka hai tatha yah yojana 2020 se chal rahi hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki bharat ki lambi tatiya rekha tatha dhaam ke talaab bahut bada samudri bhandaar rakhte hain, isliye muft mali, beej, talaab tatha shital ghar ki sahayata se matsy-palan badha kar niryat badhana sambhav hai. Blue Revolution isi kshetra ka purana karyakram hai, Deep Ocean Mission gehre samudra ko dekhta hai tatha Sagarmala bandargaah tatha jahaazraani ka kaam hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: machhali niryat doguna karne ka lakshya PMMSY ka hai - yahi matsy-palan ko bade udyog ke roop mein badhaata hai.

qe: What is the primary objective of the 'MISHTI' scheme announced in Budget 2023?
qh: बजट 2023 में घोषित 'मिष्टी' (MISHTI) योजना का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: Tatiya patti mein mangrove ugakhar kinare ko tufaan se bachane wala mission MISHTI hai, jise 2023-24 ke budget mein pesh kiya gaya. Iska mukhya kaaran yahi hai ki in pedon ki pakdi hui jadein lehron ki rafatr ko tod deti hain tatha machhali tatha kekde ko palan ka ghar deti hain, isliye yahi kshetra aise jungle ke liye chuna gaya. Matritva swasthya, mithai utpadan tatha grameen swachhata alag vishayon ke karyakram hain, isliye inhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: MISHTI yojana tatiya mangrove lagane ke liye hai - yahi tufaan se bachav tatha machhliyo ke palan ka sahayak hai.

qe: Under 'PM-KUSUM', what do farmers install to generate electricity?
qh: 'पीएम-कुसुम' के तहत बिजली पैदा करने के लिए किसान क्या स्थापित करते हैं?
e: Kheti ki sinchai ke liye saur urja se chalne wale pump lagwane ki yojana PM-KUSUM hai tatha in pumps se bachi bijli kisaan grid ko bech bhi sakta hai. Iska mukhya kaaran yahi hai ki mehanga diesel tel kisaan ki jeb par bhaari padta hai tatha uska dhuaan paryavaran ko kharab karta hai, isliye saur pump se lagat tez ghatti hai tatha kisaan ki aay badhti hai. Pawan chakki, biogas plant tatha jal-turbine is yojana ke ang nahi hain, isliye teenon galat chunav hain. Exam point: PM-KUSUM wali yojana kisaan ke khet mein saur pump lagwati hai - yahi mehange diesel ka bojh tatha pradushan ghatata hai.

qe: What is the tagline of 'Digital India'?
qh: 'डिजिटल इंडिया' का नारा क्या है?
e: Digital India ka tagline 'Power to Empower' hai, yani taknik se aam nagrik ko shakti dena; isi soch ke saath 2015 mein yah karyakram shuru hua tha. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki jab sevaen mobile tatha internet par aa jaati hain to gaon tatha sheher ka faasla khatm hota hai, isliye yahi tagline yojana ke maksad se poora mel khaati hai. Digital connectivity for all, Sabka Saath Sabka Vikas tatha Empowering the Citizen jaisi panktiyan kisi anya karyakram ki bhasha hain, isliye ye teeno galat thehrte hain. Exam point: Digital India ka tagline Power to Empower hai - yahi taknik ke zariye nagrik ko saashakt karne ki soch darust karta hai.

qe: The 'PM-SHRI' scheme is related to which sector?
qh: 'PM-SHRI' योजना किस क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
e: PM-SHRI yojana vidyalaya (school) tatha shiksha ke kshetra se judi hai, jismein desh ke chune hue sarkari schoolon ko adhunik suvidhaon tatha padhai se sudhaarne ka lakshya hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki NEP 2020 ke tehat har bachche ko gunvatta wali padhai milni chahiye, isliye yahi yojana schoolon ko aakanshi star par le jaane ka zariya banati hai. Swasthya, rail tatha sadak se judi yojanaen alag hain, isliye inmein se koi sahi nahi. Exam point: PM-SHRI yojana school tatha shiksha se jude desh ke vidyalayaon ke sudhar ka karyakram hai - yahi NEP 2020 ke sankalp ko aage badhata hai.

qe: Under 'One Nation One Ration Card', migrants can get food grains from which shops?
qh: 'वन नेशन वन राशन कार्ड' के तहत प्रवासी किस दुकान से अनाज प्राप्त कर सकते हैं?
o: Any Fair Price Shop (FPS) in India
e: One Nation One Ration Card ke tehat prayojya labharthi desh ke kisi bhi aadhaar se jude uchit daam ki dukaan (Fair Price Shop) se khadyan le sakta hai, kyunki uski pahunch kisi bhi dukaan par hoti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ek jagah ka raashan card doosre rajya mein kaam nahi karta tha, isliye ghoomne tatha kaam karne wale parivar ko raashan ke liye bhatakna padta tha; ab card ko Aadhaar tatha e-POS machine se jod diya jaata hai. Keval mehango shehron, keval apne rajya tatha niji dukaanon wale vikalp purani vyavastha ki baatein hain, isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: ONORC ke tehat desh ke kisi bhi uchit daam wali dukaan se raashan milta hai - yahi ek desh ek raashan card ka sah matlab hai.

qe: What is the interest rate for 'Mahila Samman Savings Certificate'?
qh: 'महिला सम्मान बचत प्रमाणपत्र' के लिए ब्याज दर क्या है?
e: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate par 7.5 pratishat byaj milta hai tatha 2023 ke budget mein yah do saal ki chhoti avadhi ke liye laayi gayi thi. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki chhoti avadhi ki pakki bachat ka mauka chhote shehron ki mahilaon ko nahi milta, isliye pandrah hazaar se das lakh tak ki rakam par aakarshak byaj tatha do saal mein hi pai-sa-pai bhugtan diya jaata hai. Aath tatha sat pratishat kisi anya chhoti bachat yojana ke hain tatha chhe-point-paanch kisi bank ki FD ka daam, isliye ye teeno galat hain. Exam point: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate par 7.5 pratishat byaj milta hai - yahi do saal mein mahilaon ki chhoti bachat ko byaj ke saath badhaata hai.

qe: What is the primary purpose of the 'PM-DevINE' scheme announced in Budget 2022-23?
qh: बजट 2022-23 में घोषित 'PM-DevINE' योजना का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: PM-DevINE yojana ka mukhya uddeshya uttar-poorv kshetra ka vikas hai; ismein bunyaadi dhaanche tatha logon ki aajeevika se jude kaam hote hain tatha yah 2022-23 ke budget ki ghoshna thi. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki seemavarti pahadi ilaake mein niji nivesh kam aata hai, isliye is yojana ki rakam wahan sadak, bijli tatha handloom jaisi aay ke zariye pahunchai jaati hai. Bihar mein grameen aawas, raksha saamagri ka niryat tatha ladkiyon ki digital shiksha alag karyakram hain, isliye ye sab galat vikalp hain. Exam point: PM-DevINE yojana ka poora zor uttar-poorv ke rajyaon par hai - yahi wahan ke yuvaon ke liye kaam tatha dhaancha tayar karti hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide high-speed internet to all Gram Panchayats by 2025?
qh: 2025 तक सभी ग्राम पंचायतों को हाई-स्पीड इंटरनेट प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Gaon ke sabhi gram panchayat ko 2025 tak tez rafatr (high-speed) internet dene ke liye BharatNet yojana ka kaam chalta hai tatha ismein optical fibre bichhaya jaata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki internet ke bina panchayat ke daftar tatha school peeche rah jaate hain, isliye fibre optic cable ke tez chalne wale roshni sanketon se panchayat daftar tatha schoolon tak seedha network pahunchta hai. PM-WANI chhote hotspot ki yojana hai, GramNet naam ki koi sarkari yojana maujood nahi hai tatha Digital India sabhi digital karyakramon ka chhatri hai, isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: gram panchayaton tak tez internet BharatNet pahunchata hai - yahi gaon tatha sheher ke beech ka digital faasla kam karta hai.

qe: What is the maximum loan limit under the 'Shishur' category of MUDRA Yojana?
qh: मुद्रा योजना की 'शिशु' श्रेणी के तहत अधिकतम ऋण सीमा क्या है?
e: MUDRA yojana ki shishu shreni mein karz ki adhiktam seema pachaas hazaar rupaye hai tatha yahi is shreni ki tay seema hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki shishu shreni mein anubhav rahit (naye) tatha bahut chhote udyami aate hain jinki zarurat chhoti hoti hai, isliye das hazaar, ek lakh tatha paanch lakh jaise bade aankde unki chhoti zarurat se bahut upar ho jaate hain. Ye teeno anya shreniyon tatha suvidhaon ke aankde hain, isliye unhe shishu ki seema nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: MUDRA shishu shreni mein pachaas hazaar rupaye tak ka karz milta hai - yahi naye tatha bahut chhote udyami ki pehli seedhi hai.

qe: Which scheme aims to empower women through SHGs by making them 'Lakhpati Didis'?
qh: स्वयं सहायता समूहों के माध्यम से महिलाओं को 'लखपति दीदी' बनाकर सशक्त बनाने का लक्ष्य किस योजना का है?
e: Lakhpati Didi yojana ka naam hi Lakhpati Didi Scheme hai tatha iska lakshya SHG se judi mahilaon ko saalana ek lakh rupaye se adhik kamane wali banana hai; ise 2023 mein aage badhaya gaya. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki samuh ke zariye milne wale karz, prashikshan tatha bazaar se mahila doodh, murgi-palan, silai tatha dukaan jaise kaam karke apni aay lakh se upar le jaati hai. Stand-Up India alag karz yojana hai, Beti Bachao Beti Padhao betiyon ki shiksha par zor deta hai tatha Matru Vandana Yojana garbhvati mahilaon ko sahayata deti hai, isliye ye teenon galat baithte hain. Exam point: SHG mahilaon ko lakhpati banane wali yojana Lakhpati Didi hai - yahi samuh shakti se ghar ki aay badhaati hai.

qe: What is the primary objective of the 'MISHTI' scheme?
qh: 'मिष्टी' (MISHTI) योजना का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: Samundri kinare ki suraksha ke liye mangrove wale jungle lagane ka mission MISHTI hai tatha yah 2023-24 ke budget ka hissa thi. Iska mukhya kaaran yahi hai ki ye jungle tufaan ki lehron ko todte hain tatha machhliyo tatha kekdon ke palan ka sthan bante hain, isliye kinare ke gaon tatha machhuare dono ko laabh hota hai. Keval matritva ya mithai ya swachhata wale vikalp is mission ke kaam nahi hain, isliye teenon galat hain. Exam point: MISHTI yojana tatiya mangrove lagane ka mission hai - yahi tufaan se bachav tatha tatiya aay dono ka sahayak hai.

qe: Under the 'PM Vishwakarma' scheme, how many traditional trades are covered?
qh: 'पीएम विश्वकर्मा' योजना के तहत कितने पारंपरिक व्यवसायों को कवर किया गया है?
e: PM Vishwakarma yojana mein paramparik karigaron ke atharah (18) vyavsay shamil kiye gaye hain, jaise badhai, lohar, sunaar, kumhaar tatha murtikar. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki aise karigar peedhi-dar-peedhi ek hi hunar chalate hain par unke paas pahchan, karz tatha adhunik taknik nahi hoti, isliye sunishchit soochi banakar unhe prashikshan, tool kit tatha kam byaj ka karz diya jaata hai. Das, pachees tatha pandrah ki sankhya is soochi se alag hai, isliye ise sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: PM Vishwakarma yojana mein 18 paramparik vyavsay shamil hain - yahi karigaron ko samman, kaushal tatha punji teeno deti hai.

qe: What is the insurance premium for 'Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana' (PMSBY) since 2022?
qh: 2022 से 'प्रधानमंत्री सुरक्षा बीमा योजना' (PMSBY) का बीमा प्रीमियम क्या है?
e: PMSBY ke tehat 2022 ke baad bhi varshik prem bees rupaye hi hai tatha yahi rakam bank khate se saalana auto-debit hoti hai. Iska mukhya kaaran yahi hai ki chhote khate tatha kam aay wale majdoor ke liye halka shulk hi sambhav hota hai, phir bhi durnaghtna ki soorat mein do lakh rupaye tatha aadhi kami wale nuksaan par ek lakh rupaye ka bhugtan mil jaata hai. Sau tatha baarah ke aankde anya suvidhaon ke hain tatha 436 rupaye jeevan beema (PMJJBY) ka prem hai, isliye ise sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: PMSBY ka varshik prem bees rupaye hi rehta hai - itni chhoti rakam mein do lakh tak ki durnaghtna suraksha isi yojana ki khaas baat hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide solar-powered pumps to farmers?
qh: किसानों को सौर ऊर्जा से चलने वाले पंप प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Diesel pump ki jagah saur urja se chalne wale pump dene ka karyakram PM-KUSUM hai, jiska lakshya mehange tel ka bojh kam karna hai. Iska mukhya kaaran yahi hai ki saur pump din mein bijli banate hain tatha unse bachi bijli grid ko bechkar kisaan alag kamai kar sakta hai; isse kheti ki lagat ghate tatha pradushan bhi kam ho. Solar Study Lamp chhatraon ke liye hai, SAUBHAGYA gharon tak roshni pahunchata hai tatha UJALA sasti LED baantta hai, isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: kisaan ke khet mein saur pump wali yojana PM-KUSUM hai - yahi diesel ke kharch tatha dhuen dono ko kam karti hai.

qe: Which mission was launched to promote the use of 'Green Hydrogen' in India?
qh: भारत में 'ग्रीन हाइड्रोजन' के उपयोग को बढ़ावा देने के लिए कौन सा मिशन शुरू किया गया था?
e: Green hydrogen ko badhane ke liye National Green Hydrogen Mission shuru ki gayi hai, jismein navikarniya bijli se paani todkar hydrogen banaya jaata hai tatha 2030 tak paanch million ton ka nishana tay kiya gaya hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki jab ye hydrogen naveekaran urja se banaye to isse koi pradushan nahi hota, isliye ise khanan, khaad tatha bhaari vahanon mein diesel ki jagah use karne ki soch hai. PM-KUSUM saur pump ki yojana hai, Hydrogen India Mission naam ki koi yojana nahi hai tatha Mission Solar alag karyakram hai, isliye ye teenon theek nahi hain. Exam point: green hydrogen ko badhane wala mission National Green Hydrogen Mission hai - yahi saaf indhan se desh ko aatmanirbhar banata hai.

qe: What is the primary objective of the 'PM-DevINE' scheme announced in the 2022 Union Budget?
qh: 2022 के केंद्रीय बजट में घोषित 'PM-DevINE' योजना का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: 2022 ke kendriya budget mein ghoshit PM-DevINE yojana uttar-poorv kshetra ke vikas ke liye hai tatha iska poora naam Prime Minister's Development Initiative for North East Region hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki uttar-poorv ke aath rajya seema se jude tatha pahadi hain, jahan niji nivesh kam aata hai; isliye yahi yojana wahan aajeevika tatha dhaanche ke kaam khud karati hai. Ladkiyon ki digital shiksha, karz ka seedha nivesh tatha Bihar mein grameen aawas kisi doosri yojana ke kaam hain, isliye ye teeno sahi vikalp nahi hain. Exam point: PM-DevINE ka daayra uttar-poorv kshetra hai - poora naam isi baat ko darshata hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide high-speed '5G' connectivity testing for startups and industry players?
qh: स्टार्टअप और उद्योग के लिए हाई-स्पीड '5G' कनेक्टिविटी परीक्षण प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Khanan tatha karkhanaon, udyog ke liye paanch ji (5G) ke parikshan ki suvidha dene wale karyakram ka naam 5G Testbed hai, jise IITs tatha anya sansthaon ne milkar tayar kiya tatha sarkar ne iski laagat uthayi. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki 5G ke yantra tatha software par desh ke startup tatha vidvan kaam kar sakein, isliye unhe parikshan ke liye videsh nahi jaana padta. PM-WANI chhote wifi hotspot ki vyavastha hai, BharatNet 2.0 mein gaon tak fibre pahunchta hai tatha Digital India ek chhatri karyakram hai, isliye inhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: 5G Testbed 5G ke parikshan ke liye bana desh ka test dhaancha hai - yahi startup tatha udyog ko nayi taknik apnaane mein madad karta hai.

qe: The 'PM-Kisan Maandhan Yojana' (PM-KMY) provides a monthly pension of how much to small farmers?
qh: 'पीएम-किसान मानधन योजना' (PM-KMY) छोटे किसानों को कितनी मासिक पेंशन प्रदान करती है?
e: PM-Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY) ke tehat chhote tatha seemant kisaan ko 60 varsh ki aayu ke baad har mahine teen hazaar rupaye ki pension di jaati hai tatha ismein kisaan ka chhota yogdan tatha sarkar ka barabar rakam jama hota hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki badhape par kisaan ke paas bharosemand aay nahi hoti, isliye 18 se 40 varsh ki aayu mein jude kisaan ko yahi yojana bharpur bharosa deti hai. Ek hazaar, paanch hazaar tatha do hazaar rupaye ke vikalp is vyavastha ki sahi rakam nahi hain, isliye inhe theek nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: PM-KMY ke tehat har mahine teen hazaar rupaye ki pension milti hai - yahi chhote kisaan ke budhape ka sahara hai.

qe: What is the focus of the 'Deep Ocean Mission' launched by the Ministry of Earth Sciences?
qh: पृथ्वी विज्ञान मंत्रालय द्वारा शुरू किए गए 'डीप ओशियन मिशन' का फोकस क्या है?
e: Samundar ki gehrai mein chhupi sampada, khanij tatha jeevon ki jankari lene wala Deep Ocean Mission samundar tatha prithvi vigyan mantralaya chalata hai tatha ismein manned submersible tatha polymetallic nodules par kaam shamil hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki gehre samundar mein tamrap tatha nikal jaise khanij aur anokhe jeev rahte hain, isliye inhe samajhne tatha unka vishleshan karne se desh ko khanan tatha dawai ke kshetra mein laabh mil sakta hai. Tatiya safai, samundri sena ka prashikshan tatha paani ke neeche surang banana is mission ka kaam nahi hai, isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: Deep Ocean Mission samundar ki gehrai ki sampada tatha jeevon ka adhyayan karta hai - yahi bhavishya ke khanan ka rasta kholta hai.

qe: Which scheme ensures 'Clean Energy' through ethanol blending in petrol?
qh: पेट्रोल में इथेनॉल सम्मिश्रण के माध्यम से 'स्वच्छ ऊर्जा' सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Petrol mein ethenol (ethanol) ka mishran badhakar vahanon ke dhuen ko saaf karne wala karyakram E20 Programme hai, jismein 2025-26 tak bees pratishat mishran ka nishana tay hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ethenol ganna tatha anaj se banta hai tatha jalta saaf hai, isliye isse tel ki aayat ghate tatha pradushan kam ho; yahi scheme desh ke kisaanon ko bhi faayda deti hai. UJALA saste bulb ki yojana hai, KUSUM saur pump par kaam karti hai tatha Green Hydrogen Mission hydrogen par, isliye ise sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: petrol mein ethenol milane wala karyakram E20 hai - yahi tel ki aayat tatha pradushan dono ghatata hai.

qe: What is the maximum investment limit in 'Senior Citizen Savings Scheme' (SCSS) as per the 2023 budget?
qh: 2023 के बजट के अनुसार 'वरिष्ठ नागरिक बचत योजना' (SCSS) में अधिकतम निवेश सीमा क्या है?
e: Buzurg nagrikon ki bachat yojana (SCSS) mein 2023 ke baad ek vyakti adhiktam tees lakh rupaye jama kar sakta hai tatha pandrah lakh rupaye wali purani seema badhal di gayi thi. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki saath varsh se adhik ke buzurgon ke paas bachat hoti hai par unhe byaj wali surakshit jagah ki talash rehti hai, isliye seema badakar unhe surakshit tatha thoda adhik byaj wali jagah di gayi. Bees lakh, pandrah lakh tatha pachaas lakh ke aankde is nayi seema se alag hain, isliye ye teeno galat thehrte hain. Exam point: SCSS mein adhiktam jama tees lakh rupaye hai - yahi buzurgon ki badi bachat ko surakshit jagah deti hai.

qe: Which mission focuses on the development of 'Inland Waterways' for cargo movement in the Ganga river?
qh: गंगा नदी में माल की आवाजाही के लिए 'अंतर्देशीय जलमार्ग' के विकास पर कौन सा मिशन केंद्रित है?
e: Ganga jal marg par maal le jaane wale jahaazon tatha jal marg ke vikas ke liye Jal Marg Vikas Project chal raha hai, jismein Varanasi tatha Haldia ke beech safar tatha terminal banaye ja rahe hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki gaadi se mal dhone par sadak par bojh badhta hai, isliye jal marg par mal bhejna sasta tatha paryavaran ke liye behtar hota hai. Setu Bharatam purane pulon ki marmmat ka karyakram hai, Bharatmala sadak banati hai tatha Sagarmala bandargaah tatha samudri jal marg dekh raha hai, isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: Ganga par jal marg ke vikas ka kaam Jal Marg Vikas Project karta hai - yahi jal par sasta mal bhejne ka rasta banata hai.

qe: The 'Mahila E-Haat' portal was launched to support which group?
qh: 'महिला ई-हाट' पोर्टल किस समूह का समर्थन करने के लिए लॉन्च किया गया था?
e: Mahila E-Haat portal mahila udyamiyon tatha svayn sahayata samuhon ke utpad ko online bazaar se jodta hai tatha ise mahila tatha bal vikas mantralaya chalata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki gaon ki mahila ke paas saaman banane ka hunar hota hai, par kharidar tak pahunchne ka zariya nahi hota, isliye yahi portal bina beech wale ke samaan bikne ka mauka deta hai. Keval mahila doctor, keval vidhwa tatha mahila chhatra wale vikalp is daayre se alag hain, isliye ise sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: Mahila E-Haat mahila udyami tatha SHG ke samaan ka online bazaar hai - yahi hunar ko aay mein badalta hai.

qe: Which scheme aims to provide financial support to startups via a fund of funds managed by SIDBI?
qh: SIDBI द्वारा प्रबंधित फंड ऑफ फंड्स के माध्यम से स्टार्टअप्स को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने का लक्ष्य किस योजना का है?
e: Seed Fund Scheme ke tehat startup ko badhne ke liye shuruati punji di jaati hai tatha paisa SIDBI wale fund of funds ke zariye pahunchta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki naye startup ke paas tayar samaan hota hai par uske kharidar tatha aage chalane ka kharach nahi, isliye ye rakam ushe sanstha chalaane tatha bazaar tak pahunchne mein madad karti hai. MUDRA aur Stand-Up India paramparik karobar ko karz dete hain tatha PMEGP chhote udyog mein subsidy deta hai, isliye inmein se koi sahi nahi. Exam point: startup ko shuruati punji wali yojana Startup India Seed Fund Scheme hai - yahi naye udyog ko shuru se chalane mein madad karti hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched for the 'Digitalization of Land Records' across India?
