qh: पूरे भारत में 'भूमि अभिलेखों के डिजिटलीकरण' के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: DILRMP yani Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme desh bhar mein zameen ke kagaz tatha naqshon ko computer par laane wala karyakram hai, kyunki yahi is kaam ki mukhya yojana ka sah naam hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki zameen ke purane bahi-khate jhagde tatha dhoka ka bada zariya hote the, isliye abhilekh ko computer par laakar aam nagrik ko online jankari (Record of Rights) tatha nakal mil jaati hai. PMAY aawas ki yojana hai, SVAMITVA gaon ki sampatti ka nakshe drone se banati hai tatha PMGSY sadak bichaati hai, isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: zameen ke kagaz ko digital karne wala karyakram DILRMP hai - yahi zameen ke jhagde tatha dhoka hataane mein madad karta hai.

qe: Under 'Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana' (PMKVY), who is the primary implementing agency?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री कौशल विकास योजना' (PMKVY) के तहत प्राथमिक कार्यान्वयन एजेंसी कौन सी है?
e: PMKVY ko logon ka kaushal badhane ke liye chalane wali mukhya sanstha National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) hai tatha yahi sanstha prashikshan dene wale kendra chunati tatha nigrani karti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki sarkar ne yojana ka kaam ek aisi aavashyak sanstha ko saunpa hai jo udyog tatha sarkar dono ka sahyog leti hai, isliye prashikshan ke baad praman patra tatha rozgar melon ka prabandh hota hai. Grih mantralaya, Reserve Bank tatha NITI Aayog ke kaam alag hain, isliye inmein koi sahi nahi hai. Exam point: PMKVY chalane wali mukhya sanstha NSDC hai - yahi yojana ko udyog ki zarurat ke hisaab se kaushal deti hai.

qe: What is the 'PM-Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana' (PMBJP) motto?
qh: 'पीएम-भारतीय जनऔषधि परियोजना' (PMBJP) का आदर्श वाक्य क्या है?
e: PMBJP ka motto Sasti Dawa, Achhi Dawa hai tatha iska maksad aam logon ko sahi daam par jenerik dawa pahunchana hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki brand wali dawa mehangi hoti hai, isliye yahi yojana gareeb tatha madhyam varg tak sasti tatha gunvatta wali dawa dawa kendron ke zariye pahunchaati hai. Generic medicines for all tatha Health is Wealth kisi yojana ka motto nahi hain tatha None of these kathan galat hai, kyunki sahi motto upar diya hua hai. Exam point: Janaushadhi yojana ka motto Sasti Dawa, Achhi Dawa hai - yahi paisa bachate hue achhi dawa pahunchata hai.

qe: Which scheme focuses on providing a tap water connection to every urban household in 500 cities?
qh: 500 शहरों में प्रत्येक शहरी घर को नल से जल कनेक्शन प्रदान करने पर कौन सी योजना केंद्रित है?
e: Shehron ke ghar-ghar tak nal se paani pahunchane ke liye AMRUT 2.0 yojana chal rahi hai, jismein paanch sau shehron mein nal-jal tatha sewer ki suvidha ka lakshya hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki shehron ki gandagi tatha gharelu paani ki dikkat sabse bada swasthya khatra hai, isliye nal se saaf paani tatha gaya-bahaav (sewer) ka prabandh saath le jaane par bimariyan ghatti hain. Jal Jeevan Mission Urban naam ki alag yojana nahi hai, HRIDAY dharohar yukt shehron ka karyakram hai tatha Smart Cities alag vichar hai, isliye ise sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: shehri gharon tak nal se paani AMRUT 2.0 ke tehat pahunchta hai - yahi saaf paani tatha safai dono ka sahayak hai.

qe: The 'NIPUN Bharat' scheme covers children in which age group?
qh: 'निपुण भारत' योजना किस आयु वर्ग के बच्चों को कवर करती है?
e: NIPUN Bharat yojana teen se nau varsh ki aayu ke bachchon ke liye hai, ismein unhe padhne tatha ganit ki buneeyadi kshamata dene par zor hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki is aayu mein seekha hua aage zindagi bhar kaam aata hai, isliye aanganwadi tatha shuruati kakshaon mein hi unhe akshar, matra tatha ginti ka aabhyaas karaya jaata hai. Das se atharah, chhe se chaudah tatha zero se chhe varsh wale vikalp is daayre se alag hain, isliye ye teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: NIPUN Bharat yojana teen se nau varsh ke bachchon ki buneeyadi padhai tatha ganit ke liye hai - yahi NEP 2020 ka zariya hai.

qe: Which mission aims to convert 'Barren Land' into fertile land through organic practices?
qh: जैविक प्रथाओं के माध्यम से 'बंजर भूमि' को उपजाऊ भूमि में बदलने का लक्ष्य किस मिशन का है?
e: Banjhar bhumi ko jaivik (organic) tarike se upjau banane par zor dene wali yojana National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture hai, jo kheti ko jalvayu ke hisaab se tay karne tatha jaivik khad ka istemal badhane par kaam karti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki rasayanik khad tatha adhik sinchai se zameen banjhar hoti jaati hai, isliye jeevamrit, harit khad tatha fasal chakra se mitti ki urvarata laut kar aati hai. Soil Health Mission mitti ki jaanch tak seemit hai, Per Drop More Crop boom par drip sinchai ka ang hai tatha Green India Mission jungle lagane ka karyakram hai, isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: banjhar bhumi ko jaivik tarike se upjau banane wali yojana National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture hai - yahi mitti ki sehat ko bachati hai.

qe: The 'SAMARTH' scheme is related to capacity building in which industry?
qh: 'समर्थ' (SAMARTH) योजना किस उद्योग में क्षमता निर्माण से संबंधित है?
e: SAMARTH yojana vastra (textile) udyog mein kaushal tatha shamta badhane ke liye chalayi ja rahi hai, jismein taknik, ghatiya urja tatha gunvatta wale utpadan par kaam hota hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki bharat duniya ka bada vastra utpadak hone ke baad bhi niryat mein peeche hai, isliye udyog mein kaushal tatha naye tareeke seekhkar niryat badhane ka lakshya hai. Food Processing, Steel tatha Automobile ke kshetra is yojana ka daayra nahi hain, isliye teenon vikalp galat hain. Exam point: SAMARTH yojana vastra udyog mein kaushal badhane ke liye hai - yahi vastra niryat ko badhane ka rasta hai.

qe: Under 'Ayushman Bharat', what is the dedicated health cover for all senior citizens (70+)?
qh: 'आयुष्मान भारत' के तहत सभी वरिष्ठ नागरिकों (70+) के लिए समर्पित स्वास्थ्य कवर क्या है?
e: Ayushman Bharat ke tehat saattar saal tatha usse adhik umar ke sabhi buzurg nagrikon ko alag se paanch lakh rupaye ka health cover Ayushman Vay Vandana ke naam se milta hai. Iska mukhya kaaran yahi hai ki is umar mein ilaj ka kharach sabse bhaari ho jaata hai, isliye bina kisi jhanjhat ke yahi pakki suraksha di jaati hai. Das lakh, do lakh tatha teen lakh ke aankde anya yojanaon ke hain, isliye teenon galat aankde hain. Exam point: 70 varsh tatha usse adhik ke buzurgon ko paanch lakh ka alag cover milta hai - yahi budhape mein ilaj ka bojh hataata hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide 'Drone' training specifically to women SHGs?
qh: विशेष रूप से महिला SHGs को 'ड्रोन' प्रशिक्षण प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Kheti mein chhidkav karne ka kaam mahilaon ke samuh ko saunpne wali yojana Namo Drone Didi hai, jismein yantra kharidne ke liye rupaye ki madad bhi di jaati hai. Hum ise isliye zaroori mante hain ki dawa tatha khaad barabar matra mein tezi se chhidakte hain, isse kisaan ka kharch bachta hai tatha samuh ki mahila ko alag kamai milti hai. Saur pump wali yojana bijli par kaam karti hai, SHG ki aay badhane wali yojana drone chalana nahi sikhhati tatha Drone Shakti naam ki koi yojana maujood hi nahi hai, isliye ise sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: mahilaon ke samuh ko drone sahchalit karne ka hunar Namo Drone Didi yojana deti hai - yahi unke liye kheti ka alag rozgar tatha aay ka rasta kholti hai.

qe: What is the 'PM-Kisan' income support amount paid per installment?
qh: 'पीएम-किसान' आय सहायता राशि प्रति किस्त कितनी दी जाती है?
e: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi mein saalana chhah hazaar rupaye teen barabar hisson mein diye jaate hain, isliye ek kisht mein do hazaar rupaye milte hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki kheti mein beej tatha khaad ka kharach mausam ke shuru mein hi padta hai, isliye har chaar mahine mein chhoti rakam milne se kisaan ko ek saath badi bharpai nahi karni padti tatha paisa seedha khate mein aata hai. Teen hazaar, ek hazaar tatha chhah hazaar ke aankde saalana rakam tatha doosri kishton ke hain, isliye ye teenon theek nahi hain. Exam point: PM-Kisan ki ek kist do hazaar rupaye ki hoti hai - yahi chhoti sahayata mausam-bhar kisaan ke kaam aati hai.

qe: Which mission is focused on 'Zero Hunger' and reducing malnutrition in women/children?
qh: 'शून्य भूख' और महिलाओं/बच्चों में कुपोषण को कम करने पर कौन सा मिशन केंद्रित है?
e: POSHAN 2.0 ka lakshya bhukh khatm karna tatha mahilaon tatha bachchon mein kuposhan ghatana hai; ismein aanganwadi, khaane-paani ki vividhta tatha poshan vatika shamil hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki kam wazan ka bachcha tatha kam khun wali mahila aage badi bimariyon ki chapat mein aa jaate hain, isliye jal, sanitaishan, shaadi ki umar tatha paudh-roshan har taraf ka sudhar ek hi yojana mein jod diya gaya. Clean India Mission shuddhata ka karyakram hai, Indradhanush teeke lagata hai tatha Green Revolution khaadyan utpadan badhane ka abhiyan tha, isliye ye sab galat chunav hain. Exam point: bhukh tatha kuposhan se ladne wala mission POSHAN 2.0 hai - yahi khaane-paani tatha poshan par samenkit roop se kaam karta hai.

qe: Under 'Stand-Up India', the loan must be repaid within how many years?
qh: 'स्टैंड-अप इंडिया' के तहत ऋण कितने वर्षों के भीतर चुकाया जाना चाहिए?
e: Stand-Up India ke karz ki bharpai ke liye saat saal ki avadhi di jaati hai tatha shuru ke ek saal-aath mahine moratorium yani bharpai ki chhoot ke roop mein milte hain. Yah khidki isliye rakhi gayi hai ki naye karobar ko dhaanche tatha kharidar banane mein samay lagta hai, isliye shuru mein hi badi kisht dena mumkin nahi hota; karz ki rakam das lakh se ek crore rupaye ke beech hoti hai. Paanch saal bahut kam samay hai, jabki barah tatha das saal is yojana ki tay shart se alag hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Stand-Up India ke karz ki bharpai saat saal mein hoti hai tatha shuruati mahine chhoot ke roop mein milte hain.

qe: What is the purpose of the 'PMAY-G' dashboard 'AwaasSoft'?
qh: 'PMAY-G' डैशबोर्ड 'AwaasSoft' का उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Real-time monitoring and tracking of house construction progress
e: AwaasSoft PMAY-G ka management information system yani dashboard hai jismein ghar ke nirman ki pragati par haqeeqat mein nigrani (real-time monitoring) tatha tracking hoti hai; labharthi ka naam, kist tatha geo-tagging wali tasveer wahan darj hoti hai. Yah system isliye zaroori hai ki sarkari rakam seedha labharthi ke khate mein jaati hai, isliye pehli, doosri tatha teesri kist usi kaam ke hisaab se jaari hoti hai; gram sabha tatha social audit ke record bhi isi par milte hain. Samaan kharidna, nagrik panjikaran tatha thekedaron ko paisa dena is dashboard ka kaam nahi hai, isliye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: PMAY-G ke AwaasSoft dashboard se ghar ke nirman ki nigrani tatha tracking hoti hai - yahi kist jaari karne ka aadhaar hai.

qe: Which scheme was recently launched to provide free electricity up to 300 units monthly through rooftop solar?
qh: छत पर सौर ऊर्जा के माध्यम से मासिक 300 यूनिट तक मुफ्त बिजली प्रदान करने के लिए हाल ही में कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Chhat par saur panel lagwakar har mahine teen sau unit tak muft bijli dene wali nayi yojana PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana hai, jise 2024 mein shuru kiya gaya tatha ismein ek crore gharon ka lakshya hai. Iska tark yahi hai ki chhat par bani bijli ghar ke kharch mein lagti hai tatha bachi bijli grid ko bechkar bachat hoti hai, isliye sarkar panel lagane par anudaan bhi deti hai. PM-KUSUM kisaan ke pump ke liye hai, Solar City Mission shehri soch hai tatha SAUBHAGYA gharon ko grid se jodta hai, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: chhat ke saur panel se teen sau unit tak muft bijli PM-Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana deti hai.

qe: What is the maximum subsidy for a 2kW rooftop solar system under 'PM-Surya Ghar' scheme?
qh: 'पीएम-सूर्य घर' योजना के तहत 2kW रूफटॉप सोलर सिस्टम के लिए अधिकतम सब्सिडी क्या है?
e: Do kW ke chhat wale saur system par PM-Surya Ghar ke tehat sath hazaar rupaye ki subsidy milti hai, yani pehle do kilowatt ke liye har kilowatt par tees hazaar rupaye. Yah ganit isliye bana hai ki ghar ka aam khapat do se teen kilowatt ke panel se poora ho jaata hai, isliye teesre kilowatt par pandrah-se-atharah hazaar rupaye tatha usse aage kam sahayata milti hai; karz bhi sasta milta hai. Exam point: Pachhattar hazaar, paintalis hazaar tatha tees hazaar ke aankde alag ganit ke hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: The 'PM-VIKAS' scheme is aimed at the development of which community?
qh: 'पीएम-विकास' (PM-VIKAS) योजना किस समुदाय के विकास के लिए है?
e: PM-VIKAS yani Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan yojana alpasankhyak (minority) samudayon ke hunarmand vyaktiyon, vishesh roop se mahilaon ke kaushal tatha rozgar par kaam karti hai tatha ise alpasankhyak karyakarta mantralaya chalata hai. Iska tark yahi hai ki ye samuday purane hunar tatha dastkari se jude hain par unhe bazaar, karz tatha pahchan nahi milti, isliye yahi yojana unhe samvriddhi tatha hunar dono deti hai. Exam point: Rehri-path wale PM SVANidhi tatha karigar PM Vishwakarma yojana se judte hain tatha machhuare matsy-palan ke karyakram ke hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Under 'PM-POSHAN', the scheme now covers children in which additional category?
qh: 'पीएम-पोषण' के तहत, योजना अब किस अतिरिक्त श्रेणी के बच्चों को कवर करती है?
e: POSHAN wali yojana 2022 mein apne daayre ko badhakar balvatika yani shuruati kaksha (pre-primary) ke bachchon ko bhi shamil kar chuki hai, isliye yahi sahi uttar hai. Yah badlav isliye laaya gaya ki jab bachche aanganwadi chhodkar school aa jaate hain to unka poshan dekhta kaun hai, yehi sawal tha; isliye aanganwadi, school tatha poshan vatika ek hi daayre mein aa gaye. Exam point: Secondary, college tatha inmein se koi nahi wale vikalp POSHAN ke daayre se alag hain, isliye teeno galat hain.

qe: Which ministry manages the 'National Beekeeping and Honey Mission' (NBHM)?
qh: 'राष्ट्रीय मधुमक्खी पालन और शहद मिशन' (NBHM) का प्रबंधन किस मंत्रालय द्वारा किया जाता है?
o: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
e: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission (NBHM) ko kheti tatha kisaan kalyan mantralaya chalata hai tatha iska poora zor madhumakhi palan tatha shahad utpadan ko badhane par hai; yahi yojana madhu kranti se judi hai. Yah karyabhag isliye wahi mantralaya sambhalta hai ki madhumakhi parvaran fasal paragan ke saath juda hai tatha usse kisaan ki aay badhti hai; cluster banakar shahad ki jaanch tatha packaged bikri ka saamarth bhi isi ke tehat hota hai. Exam point: MSME, vaanijya tatha gramin vikas mantralaya ke kaam alag-alag hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: What is the primary objective of 'Project NILGIRI' related to schemes?
qh: योजनाओं से संबंधित 'प्रोजेक्ट नीलगिरी' का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: Neelgiri tahr (pahadi bakri jaisa ek jeev) ki sankhya ghatti ja rahi thi, isliye Tamil Nadu sarkar ne Project NILGIRI shuru kiya tatha iska lakshya is jeev tatha uske rehne wale ghaas ke maidan dono ko bachana hai. Yah kaam isliye zaroori tha ki ye jeev keval neelgiri ke unche ilaake mein milta hai tatha iski sankhya teen hazaar ke aas-paas reh gayi thi; sanrakshan ke saath samuday ki sahabhagita bhi jodi gayi. Exam point: Daigital saaksharta, tez rail tatha chai niryat ke kaam is project se alag hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Which portal is used for the registration of MSMEs to avail government benefits?
qh: सरकारी लाभ प्राप्त करने के लिए MSMEs के पंजीकरण हेतु किस पोर्टल का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Ghar par lagne wale chhote karobar tatha karkhane ko sarkari suvidhaon ka hakk dilane ke liye Udyam Registration Portal par maatr aadhaar tatha pan daalkar muft panjikaran hota hai; yahi panjikaran Udyog Aadhaar ka naya roop hai tatha MSMEs ke liye yahi pehli shart maani jaati hai. Yah vyavastha isliye aayi ki pehle kayi alag praman-patra tatha daftar ke chakkar the, isliye ek portal se udyami ko karz, subsidy tatha sarkari kharid (GeM) ka faayda aasaani se milta hai. Exam point: GeM kharid ka platform hai, MSME Samadhaan bhugtan ke jhagde ka portal hai tatha CHAMPIONS mate-preshani tatha haath thaamne ka karyakram hai, isliye ye teeno galat hain.

qe: What is the main goal of 'Mission Vatsalya'?
qh: 'मिशन वात्सल्य' का मुख्य लक्ष्य क्या है?
e: Bachchon ki suraksha tatha kalyan ke liye chalne wali yojana Mission Vatsalya hai, jise mahila tatha bal vikas mantralaya chalata hai tatha ismein bal ashram, sponsharship, palak-maa-baap (foster care) tatha apna sahara jaise hisse shamil hain. Yah vyavastha isliye bani ki anath tatha khatre wale bachchon ke liye pehle bikhere hue karyakram chalte the, isliye ek hi jhatke ke daayre mein suraksha tatha punarvas ka kaam hota hai. Exam point: Shiksha, matritva swasthya tatha teekakaran alag yojanaon ke vishay hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Under 'PM-KISAN', if a farmer family includes a person who paid income tax last year, are they eligible?
qh: 'पीएम-किसान' के तहत, यदि किसान परिवार में कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति शामिल है जिसने पिछले साल आयकर भरा था, तो क्या वे पात्र हैं?
e: PM-KISAN ka labh keval aise kisaan parivaron ko milta hai jo pehle se aay-kar dene wale daayre mein nahi hain, isliye yadi parivar ka koi sadasya aay-kar (income tax) bhar chuka hai to wo parivar is daayre se bahar ho jaata hai tatha uttar hai - nahi. Yah shart isliye rakhi gayi ki seemit sahayata ki rakam sabse zyada zarurat wale kisaanon tak pahunche tatha jinke paas anya aay ka zariya hai wo ushe pehle chhod den; sansthaagat zameen tatha aay-kar dene wale vyakti isliye bahar rakhe gaye hain. Exam point: Keval Bihar, inmein se koi nahi tatha haan wale vikalp is tay niyam se alag hain, isliye teeno galat hain.

qe: Which scheme aims to provide health insurance to the entire population of Jammu and Kashmir?
qh: जम्मू और कश्मीर की पूरी आबादी को स्वास्थ्य बीमा प्रदान करने का लक्ष्य किस योजना का है?
e: Jammu tatha Kashmir ke sabhi nivasiyon ko paanch lakh rupaye tak ka swasthya beema dene wali yojana SEHAT hai, jise 2020 mein Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY ke saath jodkar chalaa gaya tatha ismein mukhya roop se door-baithi salah (telemedicine) tatha aspatal ki suvidha hoti hai. Yah alag vyavastha isliye ki gayi ki seemavarti kshetra mein sarkari aspatal tak pahunchna mushkil hota hai, isliye sabhi nivasiyon ko bina pahchan-chhap ke suraksha di gayi. Exam point: Sirf Ayushman Bharat JK ya J and K Care naam ki alag yojana nahi hai tatha PM-JAY poore desh ki yojana hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: The 'PRITHVI' scheme (Prithvi Vigyan) covers how many sub-schemes?
qh: 'पृथ्वी' योजना (पृथ्वी विज्ञान) में कितनी उप-योजनाएं शामिल हैं?
e: Prithvi Vigyan (PRITHVI) yojana samundar, vaayu mandal, dhoomrva, jameen tatha bhukamp jaise kai kshetron ko ek saath jodne wali yojana hai tatha ismein paanch up-yojanaen shamil hain; iska zor jeev tatha mausam ki samajh badhane par hai. Yah ek-chhatri dhaancha isliye banaya gaya ki alag-alag sansthaen apna kaam khud kar rahi thin; isliye paanch hisson wali yahi rachna chuni gayi. Exam point: Das, saat tatha teen wale aankde is rachna se alag hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Which mission focuses on increasing the storage capacity and modernization of 'Warehouses' for farmers?
qh: किस मिशन का लक्ष्य किसानों के लिए 'गोदामों' की भंडारण क्षमता बढ़ाना और उनका आधुनिकीकरण करना है?
e: Kheti ke samaan tatha anaaj ko surakshit rakhne ke liye gahne gota (warehouse) yani gramin bhandaar banane wali yojana Gramin Bhandaran Yojana hai. Yah suvidha isliye zaroori hai ki fasal katne ke baad saare kisaan ek saath bech dete hain jisse daam gir jaata hai, isliye bhandaar mein rakhkar uchit samay par bechne se unhe behtar daam tatha kharab hone se bachav hota hai; ismein banane ke kharach par karz tatha subsidy bhi milti hai. Exam point: PM-Aasha, Operation Green tatha e-NAM ke kaam alag hain, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain.

qe: What is the full form of 'PRASAD' scheme?
qh: 'प्रसाद' (PRASAD) योजना का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
o: Pilgrimage Resource and Spiritual Action Drive
Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Augmentation Drive
Purity and Rejuvenation of Spiritual Action
e: PRASAD ka poora naam Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Augmentation Drive hai tatha yah yojana teerth sthalon ke vikas, safai tatha yatriyon ke sudhar se judi hai. Yah lamba naam isliye chuna gaya ki is akshar mein teerth (pilgrimage), naya jiwan (rejuvenation) tatha dharohar ke vistaar tatha spiritual (aadhyaatmik) vriddhi ki baat saaf jhalakti hai. Exam point: Nirmal roop se adhura naam ya kisi anya abhiyan ka naam bana Pilgrimage Heritage is yojana ka sah naam nahi hai, isliye baaki vikalp galat hain.

qe: Under the 'PM-E-Bus Sewa' scheme, how many electric buses will be deployed in 169 cities?
qh: 'पीएम-ई-बस सेवा' योजना के तहत 169 शहरों में कितनी इलेक्ट्रिक बसें तैनात की जाएंगी?
e: PM-E-Bus Sewa yojana ke tehat desh ke ek sau unsath shehron mein das hazaar (10,000) bijli se chalne wali busen utaari jaayengi, isliye yahi sahi aankda hai. Yah raashi isliye chuni gayi ki ye busen diesel ke kharch tatha dhuen ko ghatati hain tatha ismein city bus services ke saath-saath sadasya tatha ati-takniki dhaanche ka kaam ek saath hota hai; aadha kharach kendra tatha baaki rajya tatha sansthan uthati hai. Exam point: Bees hazaar, paanch hazaar tatha pandrah hazaar ke aankde is ghoshna se alag hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Which scheme aims to provide financial support to startups specifically in the 'Agriculture' sector?
qh: विशेष रूप से 'कृषि' क्षेत्र में स्टार्टअप्स को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने का लक्ष्य किस योजना का है?
e: Kheti ke kshetra ke naye udyamiyon tatha startup ko shuru se badhne ke liye Agri-Udaan karyakram chalta hai, jise kheti mantralaya ki RKVY wali raashi se chalaya jaata hai; ismein soch ko parakhne tatha badh kar kaam kholne ki anudaan milti hai. Yah karyakram isliye zaroori hai ki fasal ke saath-saath bhandaar, packaging tatha kheti ke yantra mein naye vichaar aage nahi badh paate, isliye unhe paisa tatha margdarshan diya jaata hai. Exam point: Startup India Agri Fund koi yojana ka naam nahi hai, Agri-Clinic suvidha failane ke liye hai tatha PM-KISAN aay sahayata deti hai, isliye ye teeno galat hain.

qe: What is the tagline of 'Make in India'?
qh: 'मेक इन इंडिया' का टैगलाइन क्या है?
e: Make in India ka tagline Zero Defect Zero Effect hai, jiska matlab hai bina kharaabi (zero defect) tatha paryavaran par bina asar (zero effect) saamaan banana. Yah pankti isliye chuni gayi ki pehle yahi shikayat thi ki bharatiya saamaan ghatiya hai tatha karkhane pradushan failate hain; isliye yahi do khaas shart utpadak ke saamne rakhi gayi tatha udyog ko praman patra bhi milta hai. Exam point: Power to Empower Digital India ka tagline hai tatha baaki do panktiyan Make in India ke sah akshar nahi hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: The 'NIDHI' program is associated with which ministry?
qh: 'निधि' (NIDHI) कार्यक्रम किस मंत्रालय से जुड़ा है?
e: NIDHI yani National Initiative for Developing and Harnessing Innovations karyakram vigyan tatha taknik mantralaya ke tehat chalta hai tatha iska kaam takniki soch ko karkhane tatha incubator ke zariye bazaar tak pahunchana hai. Yah karyabhag isliye isi mantralaya ke paas hai ki soch tatha anusandhan wahi se janm leti hain, isliye seed ki rakam, tayyari tatha margdarshan ke saath-saath ucharak tatha accelerator ke saath jodne ka kaam yahi hota hai. Exam point: Vaanijya, shiksha tatha vitt mantralaya ke daayre ise alag hain, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain.

qe: Which scheme provides an interest subsidy for loans taken by self-help groups (SHGs)?
qh: स्वयं सहायता समूहों (SHGs) द्वारा लिए गए ऋण पर कौन सी योजना ब्याज सब्सिडी प्रदान करती है?
e: Mahila svayn sahayata samuh (SHGs) ko sasta karz dilane ke liye Interest Subvention Scheme chalti hai tatha ismein saat pratishat byaj par karz milta hai, samay par bharpai karne par teen pratishat ki chhoot ke saath yahi dar chaar pratishat tak neeche aa jaati hai. Yah suvidha isliye di jaati hai ki chhote samuh ki punji kam hoti hai tatha mehange byaj par woh karobar nahi badh paate; iske saath samuh ko unka bank khata tatha shakha sakriyata ka darwaja bhi khul jaata hai. Exam point: NRLM aajeevika ka bada karyakram hai, PM-KISAN kisaanon ki aay sahayata hai tatha PMAY ghar banane ki yojana hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Under 'Namami Gange', what is the purpose of 'Ganga Gram' project?
qh: 'नमामि गंगे' के तहत 'गंगा ग्राम' परियोजना का उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Holistic development of villages on Ganga banks
e: Ganga ke kinare basne wale gaon ke sampoorn vikas ke liye Ganga Gram project chalaya jaata hai, jismein shudhata, gaya-bahaav, nal-jal tatha dharohar ke saath gaon ko saaf-suthra banane par zor hota hai. Yah kahani isliye bani ki nadi mein gandagi sirf sheher se nahi, gaon se bhi milti thi, isliye keval nalon ki safai kaafi nahi thi tatha gaon ke saath-saath jeev raksha ko bhi joda gaya. Exam point: Machhali palan, gaon ki bijli tatha chhatraon ke tablet jaisi baatein is project ka vishay nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain.

qe: The 'PM-WANI' framework focuses on which infrastructure?
qh: 'पीएम-वाणी' (PM-WANI) ढांचा किस बुनियादी ढांचे पर केंद्रित है?
e: PM-WANI framework ka zor public wifi hotspot par hai, yani aise sthaan jahan koi bhi vyakti sasti tatha khuli internet suvidha le sakta hai. Yah tark isliye kaam karta hai ki har ghar tak fibre pahunchane mein samay lagta hai, isliye chhote dukaandaar tatha gramin CSC kendra ko Public Data Office banaakar sasti internet pahunchai ja sakti hai; is dhaanche mein koi licence tatha bhaari kharch nahi hota. Exam point: Peene ka paani, sadak tatha rail ki dhaancha is framework ke vishay nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain.

qe: Which organization releases the 'Swachh Survekshan' rankings for cities?
qh: शहरों के लिए 'स्वच्छ सर्वेक्षण' रैंकिंग कौन सा संगठन जारी करता है?
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
e: Swachh Survekshan ek saalana svachchhata sarvekhan hai jise shehri kshetra ke aavaas tatha shehri karyakram mantralaya nikaalta hai tatha ismein shehron ki saaf-safai tatha kachre ke prabandhan ke aadhaar par ranking tay hoti hai. Yah karyakram isliye shuru hua ki shehron mein safai ke keval nirikshan se sudhar nahi hua, isliye jansahbhagita tatha nagrikon ke feedback par ho rahi pratispardha se shehron ko sudhar ke liye prerana mili. Exam point: NITI Aayog, World Bank tatha paryavaran mantralaya is sarvekhan ko nahi nikaalte, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: What is the maximum amount of loan under 'Tarun' category of MUDRA scheme?
qh: मुद्रा योजना की 'तरुण' श्रेणी के तहत ऋण की अधिकतम राशि क्या है?
e: Tarun shreni mein MUDRA karz ki adhiktam seema das lakh rupaye tak hai tatha isse aage ka karz tarun-plus kehlata hai; shishu mein pachaas hazaar tatha tarun mein yahi das lakh tak milta hai. Yah satar isliye tay ki gayi ki is daayre ke udyami ke paas zameen-jaydad ka sahara nahi hota, isliye bina koi bandhak (collateral) rakhe hi karz mil jaata hai tatha naye yantra se karobar badh jaata hai. Exam point: Do lakh, pachaas hazaar tatha paanch lakh ke aankde is satar se alag hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: The 'PM-Kamy' (Kisan Maandhan) requires farmers to contribute until what age?
qh: 'पीएम-काम्य' (किसान मानधन) के तहत किसानों को किस उम्र तक योगदान करना होता है?
e: PM-Kisan Maandhan Yojana mein kisaan ki taraf se yogdan saat varsh tatha pandrah varsh tak hi nahi, balki saath varsh ki aayu tak chalta hai; uske baad pension shuru ho jaati hai. Yah samay-simaa isliye rakhi gayi ki saath varsh ki aayu ke baad kheti se aay ghatne lagti hai, isliye yahi aayu jeevan-sandhya tatha kheti ke beech ka swabhavik khadaav maani gayi; jaldi judne wale ka yogdan chhota tatha der se judne wale ka bada hota hai. Exam point: Painsath, pachaas tatha chalis varsh wale vikalp is samay-sandhi se alag hain, isliye ye teeno galat hain.

qe: Which scheme was launched for the 'Digitalization of Museum' artifacts?
qh: 'संग्रहालय' की कलाकृतियों के 'डिजिटलीकरण' के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Museum mein rakhi durlabh vastuon tatha murtaon ko daigital roop dene ke liye JATAN yani virtual museum software kaam aata hai tatha ise sanskriti mantralaya ke tehat banaya gaya hai. Yah ped isliye bada zaroori tha ki bahut-si purani vastuen nami tatha chhune se kharab ho jaati hain tatha sabhi sangrahalaya khazane ko dikha nahi paate; isliye unki tasveer tatha jankari computer par daal kar janata ke liye khula kar diya gaya. Exam point: PRASAD teerth vikas ki yojana hai, HRIDAY dharohar wale shehron ka karyakram hai tatha Digi-Art naam ki koi sarkari yojana nahi hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: What is the primary target group for the 'SMILE' scheme?
qh: 'स्माइल' (SMILE) योजना के लिए प्राथमिक लक्ष्य समूह क्या है?
o: Transgender persons and persons engaged in begging
e: SMILE yani Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise yojana kinara-kash (transgender) vyaktiyon tatha bhikhari jeevan jee rahe logon ko samman tatha aajeevika dene ke liye hai, isliye yahi sahi varg hai. Yah chunav isliye kiya gaya ki yah varg pehle kisi bhi yojana mein sahi se shamil nahi tha, isliye ismein vyapak punarvas tatha rahne ka sthaan, shiksha tatha svayn-rozgar ke tatta jode gaye hain. Exam point: Grameen mahilaen, shikshak tatha berojgar yuva is yojana ke daayre mein nahi aate, isliye teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Under the 'Ujjwala 2.0', are migrant families required to show permanent residence proof?
qh: 'उज्ज्वला 2.0' के तहत, क्या प्रवासी परिवारों को स्थायी निवास प्रमाण दिखाना आवश्यक है?
e: Ujjwala 2.0 mein sthaniy nivasi hone ka praman-patra dikhana zaroori nahi hai; labharthi khud apna pata likhkar (self-declaration) aavedan de sakta hai tatha yahi suvidha yaatri parivaron tatha paindaye se laute parivaron ke liye khaas roop se laayi gayi. Yah chhoot isliye di gayi ki gaon ke aise bahut parivar pakke pate ke kagaz nahi hote, isliye wo pehle yojana se bahar reh jaate the; ab unhe bina vajah ke daftar ke chakkar kaatne ki zarurat nahi padti. Exam point: Haan, keval shehri kshetra tatha inmein se koi nahi wale vikalp is khuli chhoot se bade khinche hue hain, isliye teeno galat hain.

qe: The 'E-Shram' card is available to workers of which sector?
qh: 'ई-श्रम' कार्ड किस क्षेत्र के श्रमिकों के लिए उपलब्ध है?
e: e-Shram card keval rasmi tatha sarkari kshetra ke kaamkaji ke liye nahi, balki asangathit kshetra ke shramikon ke liye banaya gaya hai; ismein nirmaan mazdoor, gharelu kaamkaji, rehri-path wale tatha kheti mazdoor shamil hain. Yah pehchan-patra isliye banaya gaya ki in kaamkaji ke paas samajik suraksha ka koi daayra nahi hota, isliye iske nambar se durnaghtna beema tatha pension jaisi suvidhaon ka rasta khulta hai. Exam point: Saangathit, sarkari tatha niji kaamkaji saangathit kshetra ke hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Which mission focuses on improving 'Health infrastructure' specifically at the block and district levels?
qh: किस मिशन का लक्ष्य विशेष रूप से ब्लॉक और जिला स्तर पर 'स्वास्थ्य बुनियादी ढांचे' में सुधार करना है?
e: Bimariyon se ladne ki taiyari ke liye block tatha zila star par chikitsa tatha jan-swasthya ki dhaancha sudharne wala karyakram Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM) hai. Yah tarika isliye chuna gaya ki korona kaal mein saaf dikha ki chhote star ki jaanch-shala tatha sankraman ki nigrani kamzoor thi, isliye zila tatha block par jaanch-shala, sentinel sthal tatha dhaancha khadi karna iska mukhya kaam hai. Exam point: Teekakaran, poshan tatha aam swasthya sevaen alag karyakramon ke kaam hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: What is the maximum amount that can be deposited in a 'Sukanya Samriddhi' account annually?
qh: 'सुकन्या समृद्धि' खाते में सालाना अधिकतम कितनी राशि जमा की जा सकती है?
e: Sukanya Samriddhi khate mein ek saal mein jama ki adhiktam seema dedh lakh (1.5 lakh) rupaye hai; isse upar ki rakam par byaj nahi milta tatha khata nirikshan mein aa sakta hai. Yah chhat isliye tay ki gayi ki yojana ka labh aam parivaron tak pahunche tatha aay-kar ki chhoot ka galat faayda bade niveshak nahi utha lein; isliye dedh lakh wala aankda chhote tatha madhyam parivar ke hisaab se hai. Exam point: Pachaas hazaar, ek lakh tatha dhai lakh ke aankde is chhat se alag hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: The 'PM-WANI' scheme provides internet access through which type of entity?
qh: 'PM-WANI' योजना किस प्रकार की इकाई के माध्यम से इंटरनेट पहुंच प्रदान करती है?
e: PM-WANI ke tehat internet suvidha dene wale chhote sthaan ko Public Data Office kehte hain, jise koi bhi dukaandaar, CSC kendra tatha sanstha khol sakti hai tatha iske liye koi licence shulk nahi lagta. Yah dhaancha isliye tayar hua ki internet ke bade network ke saath chhote sthaan judein tatha khuli wifi se aam log sasti suvidha lein; PDO ka operator, uska sangh (PDOA) tatha app provider (PANI) alag-alag sthaan hain. Exam point: Bank, dak ghar tatha keval badi kampaniyon wala vikalp is tarah ke khule network ko nahi darshata, isliye teeno galat hain.

qe: Which mission aims to make India a global hub for 'Green Hydrogen'?
qh: किस मिशन का लक्ष्य भारत को 'ग्रीन हाइड्रोजन' के लिए वैश्विक केंद्र बनाना है?
e: National Green Hydrogen Mission ka lakshya 2030 tak paanch million ton green hydrogen banao hai, isliye petrol tatha khaad ke karkhane khapat ke bade kharidar banenge. Yah mission isliye itna bada hai ki naveekaran bijli se paani todkar bana hydrogen jalne par keval bhaap deta hai, isliye ise steel, khaad tatha bhaari gaadiyon mein diesel ki jagah use karna mumkin hai. Exam point: Mission Solar India tatha PM-KUSUM bijli par kaam karte hain tatha Clean Energy Mission naam ki koi alag yojana nahi hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: What is the primary objective of 'Mission Karmayogi'?
qh: 'मिशन कर्मयोगी' का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: Sarkari karmachariyon ke vyavhaar tatha kaushal sudharne wala karyakram Mission Karmayogi hai, jismein iGOT portal par online pathyakram milte hain tatha har karmchari ka varshik kaam ka aaklan hota hai. Yah mission isliye laaya gaya ki kagaz ke niyam jaante hue bhi daftari kaam dheere chalte the, isliye iska poora zor kam karne ke tareeke, nagrik se vyavhaar tatha naye taknik ke saath kadam milane par hai. Exam point: Dharmik sudhar, khiladiyon ki tayyari tatha antariksh yaatra is program ka hissa nahi hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: What is the purpose of the 'PM-Awas Yojana (Grameen)' dashboard 'AwaasSoft'?
qh: 'पीएम-आवास योजना (ग्रामीण)' डैशबोर्ड 'AwaasSoft' का उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Monitoring and tracking progress of house construction
e: AwaasSoft PMAY-G ki poori daur ka computer par chalne wala pehredaar hai - ismein chune gaye labharthi ki soochi, kist ka adhikaar tatha shikayat ka darj hota hai. Yah soochi isliye zaroori hai ki sarkari rakam sach mein kis ghar par kharch hui, iska pakka pramaan rakhna padta hai, isliye geo-tagging wali tasveer tatha swatantra sameeksha ke bina agli kist nahi chhutne di jaati. Exam point: Bhugtan ka patra, kar tatha eent kharidna iska kaam nahi hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: The 'PMAY-G' (Gramin) aims to provide how much financial assistance for house construction in hilly areas?
qh: 'PMAY-G' (ग्रामीण) का लक्ष्य पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में घर निर्माण के लिए कितनी वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है?
e: Durgam tatha pahadi ilaakon mein ghar banane ka kharch zyada hota hai, isliye PMAY-G ke tehat wahan dedh lakh se thoda upar, yani ek lakh tees hazaar rupaye ki sahayata milti hai; mapan wale ilaakon mein ek lakh bees hazaar rupaye milte hain. Yah farq isliye rakha gaya ki pahadi dhalanon par saamaan dhona tatha nirmaan karna mehanga padta hai; iske saath shouchalaya ke liye alag rakam tatha MGNREGA ke dinon ki majdoori bhi jodi jaati hai. Exam point: Dedh lakh, do lakh tatha ek point do lakh ke aankde isi vyavastha se alag hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Under 'PM Matru Vandana Yojana', how much cash incentive is provided to pregnant women?
qh: 'पीएम मातृ वंदना योजना' के तहत गर्भवती महिलाओं को कितनी नकद सहायता दी जाती है?
e: Pehle jeevit bachche ke liye PM Matru Vandana Yojana mein paanch hazaar rupaye ki nagad sahayata kiston mein milti hai - khata khulwane par ek hazaar, chhah mahine baad do hazaar tatha teekakaran ke baad do hazaar rupaye. Yah rakam isliye kiston mein di jaati hai ki maa tatha bachche ka jaanch, teekakaran tatha aahaar ke pura sahara milta rahe; doosra bachcha beti hone par chhah hazaar rupaye ki alag vyavastha hai. Exam point: Inmein teen hazaar, chhah hazaar tatha das hazaar jaisi rakmein nahi aati, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Which scheme aims at providing 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year?
qh: कौन सी योजना एक वित्तीय वर्ष में 100 दिनों के गारंटीकृत मजदूरी रोजगार प्रदान करने का लक्ष्य रखती है?
e: Grameen kshetra ke har parivar ko ek vitta varsh mein sau din ki pakki mazdoori ki guarantee MGNREGA deta hai tatha yahi kanoon 2005 mein bana tha. Yah guarantee isliye krantikari maani jaati hai ki kaam maangne par dena sarkar ki zimmedari hai, isliye nali khodna, talab tatha sadak banane jaisa kaam lakhon parivaron ko saal bhar aay deta hai tatha ek-tihai jagah mahilaon ke liye alag se rakhi gayi hai. Exam point: PMKVY kaushal sikhata hai, NRLM samuhon ki aajeevika hai tatha DDU-GKY yuvaon ko kaushal deta hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Which government initiative launched in 2014 aims to transform India into a global manufacturing hub?
qh: 2014 में शुरू की गई किस सरकारी पहल का उद्देश्य भारत को एक वैश्विक विनिर्माण केंद्र में बदलना है?
e: 2014 mein shuru hua Make in India karyakram desh ko duniya ka bada nirmaan kaksh banana ke liye laaya gaya tha tatha isme pachees se adhik kshetra shamil hue. Yah soch isliye bani ki aam aadmi ke liye rozgar tatha aatmnirbharta dono tab tak mushkil hai jab tak saamaan yahin bane tatha nivesh aaye; isliye ek khidki (single window), svaami-dhan tatha FDI ke niyam aasan kiye gaye. Exam point: Stand Up India karz ki yojana hai, Swachh Bharat safai ka karyakram hai tatha Digital India alag vishay par kaam karta hai, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: The 'Startup India' initiative is primarily designed to:
qh: 'स्टार्टअप इंडिया' पहल मुख्य रूप से किसके लिए तैयार की गई है?
o: Support innovation and build a strong ecosystem for new businesses
Import more products from foreign startups
Encourage people to work in government jobs
e: Startup India ka mukhya kaam karkhane wale tatha naye vichaar ko sambhalna nahi, unke liye anukool mahol tatha poora sahaara khada karna hai, isliye yahi sahi uttar hai. Yah daayra isliye zaroori tha ki shuru mein pate ke kapde, kar adhiniyam (tax holiday) tatha bahar se mangaye gaye saamaan par chhoot wali jaal thi, isliye karkhana naye mahine mein hi ghar bhool jata tha; ab pahchan patra, katoti (tax) tatha seed fund ke zariye yahi jaal hataya gaya. Exam point: Videshi startup se aayat, purane udyogon ko band karna tatha sarkari naukri ki prerana is karyakram ka uddeshya nahi hai, isliye teeno galat hain.

qe: What is the purpose of 'Urban Development Programs' mentioned in the text?
qh: पाठ में उल्लिखित 'शहरी विकास कार्यक्रमों' का उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To improve basic amenities and infrastructure in urban areas
To convert all cities into forests
e: Shehron ke sabhi vikas karyakram aakhir kar ek hi kaam ke liye chalte hain - shehri logon ke liye paani, gaya-bahaav, kachra tatha pakka makan jaisi buniyadi suvidhaen tatha dhaanche ko kayam karna. Yah jod isliye zaroori hai ki shehron ki aabadi tezi se badh rahi hai, isliye alag-alag missionon ka lakshya ek hi kendra par milta hai; isliye AMRUT, Smart Cities, SBM-U tatha PMAY-U sab yahi soch ke hisse hain. Exam point: Keval mehange hotel, shehron mein aay badhaan tatha jungle banane wale vikalp is soch se bilkul alag hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: Which government initiative aims to modernize India's ports and enhance port-led connectivity?
qh: भारत के बंदरगाहों को आधुनिक बनाने और बंदरगाह-आधारित कनेक्टिविटी को बढ़ाने के लिए कौन सी सरकारी पहल शुरू की गई है?
e: Desh ke bandargaahon ko adhunik banana tatha unke saath sadak-rail ke jod se vyapaar badhane wala karyakram Sagar Mala Project hai, jismein port, khandan tatha tatiya samudayon ki aay par kaam hota hai. Yah mission isliye bana ki saamaan dhone ka sabse sasta zariya samudri marg hai, isliye jahaz ki rukai tatha bandargaah ki khapat kam karne se bharat ka niryat pravah badhta hai; isme gati-vidhi tatha tat-parivahan dono shamil hain. Exam point: Make in India, Digital India tatha Ujjwala yojana alag kshetron ke karyakram hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Which scheme was launched for the operational and financial turnaround of Power Distribution Companies (DISCOMs)?
qh: बिजली वितरण कंपनियों (DISCOMs) के परिचालन और वित्तीय सुधार के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Bijli vitran kampaniyon (DISCOMs) ke bhaari karz tatha ghate ka samadhan karne ke liye UDAY yani Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana 2015 mein laayi gayi thi, jisme rajya kampaniyon ka pachhattar pratishat karz apne upar leti hain tatha use rin-patra (bond) mein badal deti hai. Yah raah isliye nikaali gayi ki bijli ke kharch tatha line loss se ghata badhti ja rahi thi; isliye chori tatha takniki kami ghatane tatha kamai tatha kharch ke antar ko seemit karne ka lakshya rakha gaya. Exam point: Digital India, PM-KISAN tatha Saubhagya alag kaam karte hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: The 'Saubhagya' scheme (Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana) primarily aims at:
qh: 'सौभाग्य' योजना (प्रधानमंत्री सहज बिजली हर घर योजना) का प्राथमिक लक्ष्य क्या है?
e: Ghar-ghar tak bijli pahunchane wali yojana Saubhagya, yani Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana, ka lakshya desh ke sabhi gharo ko grid se jodna hai tatha gareeb parivaron ko muft connection diya jaata hai. Yah abhiyan isliye chala ki gaon mein bijli ki lin hoti thi par garib ghar andhere mein reh jaate the, isliye aakhri chhor tak khamba tatha taar jodkar meter lagane par hi yah pura hota hai; iske bina padhai tatha chhoti dhandha dono ruk jaate hain. Exam point: Saur park, koyle ka mol tatha padosi deshon ko bijli bechna iske kaam nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain.

qe: The 'Deendayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana' (DDUGJY) focuses on which aspect of rural power supply?
qh: 'दीनदयाल उपाध्याय ग्राम ज्योति योजना' (DDUGJY) ग्रामीण बिजली आपूर्ति के किस पहलू पर ध्यान केंद्रित करती है?
o: Feeder separation (Agri and Non-agri) and rural electrification
e: DDUGJY ka khaas kaam grameen bijli vyavastha ko sudharna hai, jisme kheti (agri) tatha gharelu (non-agri) feeder alag karna tatha up-kendra tatha lin ki kshati pura karna shamil hai. Feeder alag karne ki zarurat isliye padi ki kheti ke pump din mein chhutne par gaon ki roshni tatha school bhi bang ho jaati thi, isliye din mein kisaan ko tatha raat mein ghar ko bijli dene ki vyavastha bani; ismein gareeb gharon ko muft jodne ka kaam bhi hota hai. Exam point: Bail-bijli park tatha LPG cylinder ke kaam is yojana se alag hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Which scheme was introduced by merging five different schemes to promote the export of goods from India?
qh: भारत से वस्तुओं के निर्यात को बढ़ावा देने के लिए पांच अलग-अलग योजनाओं को मिलाकर कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Videsh vyapaar niti 2015 mein paanch alag yojanaon ko milakar banayi gayi yojana MEIS yani Merchandise Exports from India Scheme hai, jisme saamaan ke niryat ko do se paanch pratishat ka shulk-hitta (duty credit) patra milta hai. Yah sab ek jagah lane ki zarurat isliye padi ki pehle har kshetra ke liye alag yojana thi jisse niryatkarta ko kitabein yaad rakhni padti thin; iske baad vishw vyapaar sangathan ke faisle ke baad yahi kaam RoDTEP kar rahi hai. Exam point: Digital India, PM-Kisan tatha SEIS (sevaon ke niryat) alag vishay ke hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: What does the 'SEIS' scheme specifically focus on in India's foreign trade policy?
qh: भारत की विदेश व्यापार नीति में 'SEIS' योजना विशेष रूप से किस पर ध्यान केंद्रित करती है?
e: Bharat se sevaon ke niryat ko badhane wali yojana SEIS yani Service Exports from India Scheme hai tatha ismein it, paryatan tatha anya seva niryat par videshi mudra ki kamai ke aadhaar par puraskar (scrip) milta hai. Yah tarika isliye chuna gaya ki saamaan ki tarah sevaon mein lin taar tatha bandargaah ki taklif nahi hoti, isliye kam kharach mein videsh se mudra aane se desh ka vyapaar santulan sudhrata hai. Exam point: Sone ka aayat, fasalon ka niryat tatha bhaari machine ka nirmaan is yojana ke vishay nahi hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: The 'EPCG' (Export Promotion Capital Goods) scheme allows exporters to:
qh: 'EPCG' (निर्यात प्रोत्साहन पूंजीगत वस्तुएं) योजना निर्यातकों को क्या अनुमति देती है?
o: Export old machinery to other countries
Import capital goods at zero or concessional customs duty subject to export obligations
Avoid paying any income tax forever
e: EPCG wali yojana niryatkarta ko mehangi machine (capital goods) bina ya kam savaari-kar (customs duty) par mangwane ki suvidha deti hai. Yah chhoot isliye di jaati hai ki aadhunik yantra ke bina aaj ke bazaar mein khapat nahi ban paati; badle mein niryatkarta par yahi shart hoti hai ki wo chhah saal mein chhoot se chhah guna zyada niryat kare, isliye yahi sabse bada anushasan mana jaata hai. Exam point: Purani machine niryat, aay-kar se hamesha chhoot tatha jivan bhar muft bijli is yojana ka hissa nahi hai, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: Which Indian government scheme aims to provide 'Universal Health Coverage' and is often mentioned in the context of human development?
qh: कौन सी भारतीय सरकारी योजना 'यूनिवर्सल हेल्थ कवरेज' प्रदान करना चाहती है और अक्सर मानव विकास के संदर्भ में इसका उल्लेख किया जाता है?
e: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) ko kabhi-kabhi Modicare bhi kaha jaata hai tatha yahi yojana desh mein sarvajanik swasthya suraksha ka bada zariya hai; ismein daridra tatha kamzor parivaron ko paanch lakh rupaye tak ka saalana ilaaj muft milta hai. Yah daayra itna bada isliye banaya gaya ki aadhe se adhik log ilaaj ke kharch kaun uthayega, isliye aspatal ki chikitsa sarkar apne zime leti hai tatha yahi suvidha ek rajya se doosre rajya mein bhi chalti hai. Exam point: Make in India, Digital India tatha PM-Kisan alag vishay ke karyakram hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: The 'Shram Suvidha Portal' was launched by the government to:
qh: 'श्रम सुविधा पोर्टल' सरकार द्वारा किसके लिए शुरू किया गया था?
o: Bringing transparency and accountability in labor inspections and reporting
e: Shram Suvidha Portal manav shram mantralaya ka ek hi khidki (single window) hai jahan karkhane apne kar tatha majdoori ke kagaz jama karte hain; isse nigrani mein pardafash tatha javabdehi badhti hai. Yah vyavastha isliye bani ki pehle alag-alag daftar mein forms bhare jaate the tatha nirikshan ki timing ka pata nahi hota tha; ab ek hi aavedan se EPFO, ESIC tatha mazdoor dono ka kagaz jud jaata hai tatha nirikshan ki soochna bhi portal par milti hai. Exam point: Rail ticket, passport aavedan tatha online movie dekhna is portal ka kaam nahi hai, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: What is the primary objective of the 'Mega Food Park' scheme in India?
qh: भारत में 'मेगा फूड पार्क' योजना का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To link agricultural production to the market by providing modern infrastructure
To increase the import of food items
To provide free seeds to farmers
To provide electricity in rural areas
e: Kheti ke utpadan ko bhandaar, prasanskaran tatha bazaar se jodne ke liye Mega Food Park yojana chalti hai, jismein cold chain, gudam tatha prasanskaran ki ikai ek hi sthaan par banti hain. Yah park isliye zaroori tha ki fasal kharab hone tatha beech wale ke haath mein daam jane se kisaan ka nuksaan hota tha; isliye fasal sahi samay par bazaar tak pahunchne se niryat tatha rozgar dono badhte hain. Exam point: Videsh se khaana mangwana, muft beej baantna tatha grameen bijli dena is yojana ka kaam nahi hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Under MGNREGA, how many days of guaranteed wage employment are provided to a rural household in a financial year?
qh: मनरेगा (MGNREGA) के तहत, एक वित्तीय वर्ष में ग्रामीण परिवार को कितने दिनों के गारंटीकृत मजदूरी रोजगार प्रदान किया जाता है?
e: Ek vitta varsh mein sau din kaam dene ka vada MGNREGA ka mukhya aankda hai tatha yah sau din ek parivar ko milte hain, kisi ek vyakti ko nahi. Yah seema isliye rakhi gayi ki gaon mein kheti tatha anya kaam mausam ke hisaab se chalte hain, isliye saal mein sau din ka pakka sahara hi parivar ko beech mausam mein bhookh se bachaata hai; isi kanoon ke tehat nali, talab, paudha ropan tatha ghar se juda kaam pehle shreni mein aate hain. Exam point: Pachaas, ek sau pachaas tatha do sau din wale aankde isi vyavastha se alag hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Who is responsible for the direct implementation of MGNREGA at the local level?
qh: स्थानीय स्तर पर मनरेगा के प्रत्यक्ष कार्यान्वयन के लिए कौन जिम्मेदार है?
e: MGNREGA ka kaam gaon star par mukhya roop se gram panchayat tatha gram sabha chalaati hai, isliye yahi asli zariya hai - yahi gram sabha se yojana chunti hai tatha kaam ka record rakhti hai. Yah dhaancha isliye banaya gaya ki kaam ki jarurat sabse behtar gaon ke log jaante hain tatha unhi ko nigrani ka hakk milna chahiye; isliye kendr sarkar paisa tatha niyam deti hai, rajya karmchari tatha takniki salah deta hai. Exam point: Kendr sarkar, rajya sarkar tatha niji thekedaar wale vikalp yahi kaam nahi karte, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: In MGNREGA, if an applicant is not provided employment within 15 days, they are entitled to:
qh: मनरेगा में, यदि किसी आवेदक को 15 दिनों के भीतर रोजगार प्रदान नहीं किया जाता है, तो वे किसके हकदार हैं:
e: Kaam maangne ke pandrah din ke andar rozgar na dene par MGNREGA mein bhatta (unemployment allowance) ka hakk banta hai tatha yah rakam din-bhar ki majdoori ka aadha hissa hoti hai. Yah shart isliye rakhi gayi ki bina bhatte ke yahi guarantee khokhli ho jaati, isliye sarkar ko seema ke andar kaam shuru karne ka dabav bana rehta hai; iske alawa bhatta na dene par sarkar par jurmana bhi lagta hai. Exam point: Anaj, muft ghar tatha sarkari naukri wale vikalp is kanoon ki bhasha nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: Which scheme was specifically launched for the self-employment of the rural poor?
qh: ग्रामीण गरीबों के स्वरोजगार के लिए विशेष रूप से कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Grameen gareeb ko svayn-rozgar dene ke liye SGSY yani Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana chalti thi, jismein bank karz ke saath subsidy jodkar chhote dhandhe khade karaye jaate the. Yah karyakram isliye yaad rakha jaata hai ki yahi jod (subsidy aur karz) aage NRLM mein doharaaya gaya; ismein gaon ke gareeb parivaron ko samuh bana kar silai, murgi-palan tatha dukaan jaisi chhoti kamai ke liye punji tatha prashikshan milta tha. Exam point: SJSRY shehri kshetra ka alag karyakram tha, Total Sanitation safai ka abhiyan tha tatha Mid-Day Meal school ke khaane se juda tha, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Which scheme provides an insurance cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in India?
qh: भारत में माध्यमिक और तृतीयक देखभाल के लिए प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का बीमा कवर कौन सी योजना प्रदान करती है?
e: Daridra parivaron ko secondary tatha tertiary aspatal mein paanch lakh rupaye tak ka ilaaj saalana muft dene wali yojana Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY hai tatha ise rashtriya swasthya pradhikaran (NHA) chalati hai. Yah design isliye chuna gaya ki bade aspatal ki keemat se gareeb parivar karz mein dub jaate the, isliye bina paisa diye milne wali yahi beema unhe suraksha deti hai tatha Ayushman card se kisi bhi jude aspatal mein ilaaj ho jaata hai. Exam point: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan pension ki yojana hai, Mission Indradhanush teekakaran karta hai tatha Jan Dhan khata kholta hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: The 'POSHAN Abhiyaan' (National Nutrition Mission) aims to reduce malnutrition in which group?
qh: 'पोषण अभियान' (राष्ट्रीय पोषण मिशन) का लक्ष्य किस समूह में कुपोषण को कम करना है?
o: Children (0-6 years), pregnant women, and lactating mothers
e: Kuposhan tatha anaemia ghatane wali POSHAN Abhiyaan ka daayra shunya se chhe varsh ke bachche, garbhvati mahilaen tatha dudh pilane wali maaen hain tatha isliye yahi varg sahi hai. Yah chunav isliye kiya gaya ki jeevan ke pahle sau din tatha chhe saal tak ka poshan aage ke sharirik tatha mansik vikas ka aadhaar banata hai; isliye tay seema par kami lene tatha poshan maah tatha jansahbhagita se nirikshan hota hai. Exam point: Keval buzurg log, udyog mazdoor tatha berojgar yuva is karyakram ke daayre se alag hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: What was the record-breaking achievement of 'Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana' (PMJDY)?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री जन धन योजना' (PMJDY) की रिकॉर्ड तोड़ उपलब्धि क्या थी?
o: Opening 15 crore bank accounts for the unbanked
e: PMJDY ka bada karnama yahi hai ki usne bade paimane par khate khole tatha ek saptah mein sabse zyada khate kholne ka vishva record bhi bana; unbanked logon ke liye pandrah karod se badhkar khate khulna hi yahi upalabdhi maani jaati hai. Yah kaam isliye zaroori tha ki pehle gaon ke gareeb ke paas khata na hone se suvidhaen tatha karz ki rakam nahi pahunch paati thi; isliye shunya shunaya wala khata, RuPay card tatha durnaghtna beema is yojana ke tatta hain. Exam point: Muft bijli, do karod shouchalaya tatha muft mobile wale vikalp anya karyakramon ke hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: Under PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM), what is the minimum assured monthly pension after the age of 60?
qh: प्रधानमंत्री श्रम योगी मान-धन (PM-SYM) के तहत 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद न्यूनतम सुनिश्चित मासिक पेंशन क्या है?
e: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan mein jude asangathit mazdoor ko saath varsh ke baad kam se kam teen hazaar rupaye maasik pension milti hai tatha jeevan-sathi ko usse aadha (dedh hazaar rupaye) family pension milti hai. Yah rakam isliye tay ki gayi ki majdoor ko apne kharch ke liye itni aay chahiye hi chahiye tatha uske yogdan ki mahine ki rakam lagbhag pachpan se do sau rupaye tak hi hoti hai; uske andar sarkar barabar ki rakam jod deti hai. Exam point: Do hazaar, ek hazaar tatha paanch hazaar ke vikalp isi vyavastha se alag hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: The 'SHREYAS' scheme launched in 2019 is primarily aimed at improving:
qh: 2019 में शुरू की गई 'SHREYAS' योजना का मुख्य उद्देश्य किसमें सुधार करना है?
o: Employability of degree students through apprenticeship
e: Degree le chuke ya padh rahe yuvaon ko apprenticeship tatha kaushal se rozgaar-yogya banane wali yojana SHREYAS hai tatha ismein unhe udyog mein haath se kaam seekhne ka mauka tatha stipend milta hai. Yah yojana isliye laayi gayi ki keval degree lene par bhi yuvaon ke paas hunar nahi hota tha tatha udyog unhe kaam ke liye tayar nahi maanta tha; isliye padhai ke saath karkhane ki asli taknik jodkar yahi khali jagah bhari jaati hai. Exam point: Matritva swasthya se rahna, kheti ki upaj badhana tatha grameen safai is yojana ke kshetra nahi hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain.

qe: Under 'Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi' (PM-KISAN), how much annual financial benefit is provided to eligible farmers?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि' (PM-KISAN) के तहत पात्र किसानों को कितना वार्षिक वित्तीय लाभ प्रदान किया जाता है?
e: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi ke tehat kisaan parivar ko saal bhar mein chhah hazaar rupaye ka labh milta hai tatha yah rakam teen barabar kiston mein seedha bank khate mein aati hai. Yah raashi isliye tay ki gayi ki chhote kisaan ke samne beej, khaad tatha majdoori ka kharach mausam ke shuru mein hi aata hai, isliye saalana chhah hazaar ka pakka sahan unki lagat ka bada hissa utha leta hai; varsh 2019 se yah yojana chal rahi hai. Exam point: Das hazaar, char hazaar tatha do hazaar ke aankde is saalana vyavastha se alag hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: The 'Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana' (PMMVY) provides a cash incentive of ______ to pregnant and lactating mothers for the first living child.
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री मातृ वंदना योजना' (PMMVY) गर्भवती और स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं को पहले जीवित बच्चे के लिए ______ का नकद प्रोत्साहन प्रदान करती है।
e: Prasav ke aas-paas maa ki dekh-rekh tatha aaram ke liye jo nagad sahayata milti hai, wo PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) ke tehat paanch hazaar rupaye tay hai tatha yah rakam us samay milti hai jab wo teekakaran tatha jaanch ke niyam poore karti hai. Yah tarika isliye chuna gaya ki garbh tatha prasav ke dinon mein mahila ko kaam chhodna padta hai, isliye yahi nagad sahayata uske khaane tatha aaram ka sahara banati hai; iske saath aspatal mein prasav tatha shaishav poshan par bhi zor badhta hai. Exam point: Ek hazaar, teen hazaar tatha das hazaar ke aankde is yojana ki kiston tatha kul raashi se alag hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide free LPG connections to women from BPL households?
qh: BPL परिवारों की महिलाओं को मुफ्त एलपीजी कनेक्शन प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Chulhe ke dhuen se hone wali bimariyan ghatane ke liye 2016 mein PM Ujjwala Yojana chali tatha ismein BPL parivar ki mahilaon ko bina jama-raashi gas connection diya jaata tha. Yah soch isliye bani ki gaon ki mahilaen lakdi tatha kande se khaana banati thi jisse unke tatha bachchon ke phephde kharab hote the; isliye yojana ka nishana yahi ghar the tatha unhe saaf indhan dilaya gaya. Exam point: Saubhagya gharon ki bijli, PM Awas makan tatha Jan Dhan khata kholne se judi hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: The 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign focuses on addressing which critical issue?
qh: 'बेटी बचाओ बेटी पढ़ाओ' अभियान किस महत्वपूर्ण मुद्दे के समाधान पर केंद्रित है?
e: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao abhiyan ka mukhya nishana girte bachcha-linganupat (child sex ratio) ko sudharna tatha betiyon ki shiksha ko badhava dena hai; ise 2015 mein Panipat se shuru kiya gaya tha. Yah soch isliye bani ki ling jaanch (ultrasound) ke galat istemal se betiyan kam paida ho rahi thin, isliye ismein samajik mahol tatha PC-PNDT kanoon ke sakht paalan tatha beti ki padhai ko ek saath joda gaya. Exam point: Bade logon ki likhai, shehron mein berojgari tatha jungle katne se juda vishay is abhiyan ka daayra nahi hai, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: Under the 'Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana', what is the maximum loan limit for the 'Tarun' category?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योजना' के तहत 'तरुण' श्रेणी के लिए अधिकतम ऋण सीमा क्या है?
e: MUDRA yani Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency chhote udyami ko seedha paisa nahi deti, balki bankon, micro-finance sansthaon tatha NBFC ko sasta karz deti hai jisse wo aage udyami ko karz dein. Isi dhaanche mein shreniyaan bani hain - shishu mein pachaas hazaar tak, kishore mein pachaas hazaar se paanch lakh tatha tarun mein paanch lakh se das lakh tak ka karz aata hai. Exam point: Bees lakh, pachaas hazaar tatha pachaas hazaar se paanch lakh wale vikalp doosri shreniyon ke hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: The 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' scheme was initially launched with a special focus on which states?
qh: 'बेटी बचाओ बेटी पढ़ाओ' योजना शुरू में किन राज्यों पर विशेष ध्यान देने के साथ शुरू की गई थी?
e: Shuru ke daur mein Beti Bachao Beti Padhao ka zor Haryana, Punjab tatha Uttarakhand jaise un rajyaon par tha jahan bachchon ka linjanupat desh ke ausat se kaafi neeche tha. Yah chunav isliye kiya gaya ki sirf poore desh ko ek jaisa sandesh dene se kaam nahi chalta, balki sabse kamzor sthaan par alag se koshish chahiye thi; isliye saikdon zilon mein lin-jansankhya tatha padhai ke sudhar ke saath nigrani bhi ki gayi. Exam point: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Goa, Maharashtra, Sikkim tatha Mizoram jaise rajya is kamzori wali soochi mein shuru se shamil nahi the, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Which scheme aims to improve the living standards in villages by involving higher education institutions?
qh: उच्च शिक्षण संस्थानों को शामिल करके गाँवों में जीवन स्तर सुधारने का लक्ष्य कौन सी योजना रखती है?
e: Gaon ki zindagi ki samasyayen suljhane ke liye uchch shiksha sansthaon ko gaon se jodne wala karyakram Unnat Bharat Abhiyan hai tatha ise IIT Delhi ke sahyog se chalaya jaata hai. Yah soch isliye laayi gayi ki karkhane tatha badi taknik gaon tak nahi pahunchti, isliye chhatra tatha adhyapak gaon ke logon ki zarurat samajh kar paani, safai tatha urja ke sahi hal tayar karein. Exam point: Skill India kaushal sikhata hai, Make in India nirmaan badhaata hai tatha Digital India internet se jodta hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Which scheme provides 35 kg of food grains per month to the 'poorest of the poor' families?
qh: 'गरीबों में सबसे गरीब' परिवारों को प्रति माह 35 किलो खाद्यान्न कौन सी योजना प्रदान करती है?
e: Antyodaya Anna Yojana un parivaron ke liye hai jo bhookh ki seema par jee rahe hain tatha inhe ek parivar ko har mahine paintees kilo anaaj milta hai. Yah raashi isliye itni rakhi gayi ki itna anaaj ek parivar ke mahine ki roti ke liye kaafi hota hai; shuru mein ismein gehun teen rupaye tatha chaawal do rupaye per kilo ke mol par milta tha tatha AAY card par pehchan hoti thi. Exam point: MGNREGA kaam deta hai, PM-KISAN kisaanon ko rakam deta hai tatha Mid-Day Meal school ke bachchon ko tayaar khaana deti hai, isliye wo teeno anaj wali is vyavastha se alag hain.

qe: Under NFSA, who is considered the 'Head of the Household' for the purpose of issuing a ration card?
qh: एनएफएसए के तहत, राशन कार्ड जारी करने के उद्देश्य से किसे 'परिवार का मुखिया' माना जाता है?
o: The eldest female member (18 years or above)
e: Rashtriya khadyan suraksha adhiniyam 2013 ke tehat parivar ka mukhiya sabse badi mahila sadasy maani jaati hai jo atharah varsh ya usse adhik ki ho, isliye saamanya card mahila ke naam par banta hai. Yah siddhant isliye apnaya gaya ki yadi badi mahila ke naam par kagaz ho to anaaj parivar ke bachchon tatha khaane tak theek se pahunchta hai; parivar ka tay hissa ek saath milta hai, kisi ek vyakti ko na nahi. Exam point: Keval kaam karne wala sadasy, sabse bada purush tatha sarpanch jaisa koi roop is adhiniyam mein tay nahi hai, isliye teeno vikalp galat thehrte hain.

qe: Under the 'Antyodaya Anna Yojana', at what rates are wheat and rice currently provided?
qh: 'अंत्योदय अन्न योजना' के तहत, वर्तमान में गेहूं और चावल किस दर पर प्रदान किए जाते हैं?
e: Antyodaya card dharak ko gehun do rupaye tatha chaawal teen rupaye prati kilo ke record kam mol par milta hai tatha yahi seema kanoon mein tay hai. Yah mol isliye rakha gaya ki anaaj bilkul muft na lage isse samman ki bhaavna bani rahe tatha kuchh bhugtan karne ka dabi rehta hai; baad ke varshon mein PMGKAY ke tehat yahi anaaj bilkul muft bhi baanta gaya. Exam point: Das aur pandrah rupaye, paanch aur das rupaye tatha sabke liye muft wale vikalp is tay mol se alag hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: What is the primary objective of the 'Unnat Bharat Abhiyan'?
qh: 'उन्नत भारत अभियान' का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Connecting higher education institutions with rural development
e: Unnat Bharat Abhiyan ka khaas kaam gaon ko apnana (village adoption) hai - ismein sansthan ke adhyapak tatha chhatra ek gaon chunte hain tatha gram sabha se milkar uski vikas yojana banate hain. Yah tarika isliye chuna gaya ki har gaon ki dikkat alag hoti hai, isliye saari taknik upar se lagane se kaam nahi chalta; isliye rahne, khadyan, urja tatha aay ke samadhan gaon ki zarurat ke hisaab se banaye jaate hain. Exam point: Antriksh yaatra, smart cities tatha raksha taknik se juda vishay is abhiyan ka uddeshya nahi hai, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: Which scheme focuses on providing nutrition to school children in India?
qh: भारत में स्कूली बच्चों को पोषण प्रदान करने पर कौन सी योजना केंद्रित है?
e: School ke bachchon ko poshan tatha tayaar khaana dene wali yojana Mid-Day Meal hai, jise ab Pradhan Mantri POSHAN Shakti Nirman ke naam se chalaya jaata hai; ismein kaksha ke hisaab se paushtik khaana diya jaata hai. Yah madad isliye duniya bhar mein maani jaati hai ki isse kaksha mein bachchon ki upasthiti tatha thehraav badhta hai tatha bhookhe bachche padhai par dhyan nahi de paate, is yojana se unhe sarnidhi tatha poshan dono milte hain. Exam point: Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan schoolon ki suvidha par kaam karta hai, Indira Awas ghar banata hai tatha MGNREGA kaam deta hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Which scheme was launched to ensure food security for the 'poorest of the poor'?
qh: 'गरीबों में सबसे गरीब' लोगों के लिए खाद्य सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Antyodaya Anna Yojana un parivaron ke liye shuru ki gayi thi jo sabse gareeb maane jaate the - bhookhe-mani kho jane wale, vidhwa, divyang, buzurg tatha aise kaamkaji jinake paas pakki aay nahi hoti. Yah chunav isliye kiya gaya ki saamanya khadyan suvidha mein bhi aise parivar peeche chhoot jaate the, isliye unhe alag khadyan card diya gaya; is yojana ka naam Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya ke Antyodaya vichar se juda hai. Exam point: SGSY tatha SJSRY svayn-rozgar ke karyakram hain tatha MGNREGA mazdoori ki guarantee deta hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.

qe: Under the 'Viability Gap Funding' (VGF) scheme, the government provides financial support to projects that are:
qh: 'वायबिलिटी गैप फंडिंग' (VGF) योजना के तहत, सरकार उन परियोजनाओं को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करती है जो:
o: Economically essential but not financially viable for private players
e: Viability Gap Funding ka matlab yahi hai ki jo project desh tatha logon ke liye zaruri hai par usse karobar karne wale ko ghata hota hai, ushe sarkar kuchh ansh dene par hi niji niveshkar shuru karta hai. Yah daan isliye diya jaata hai ki bandargaah, sadak tatha bypass jaisi dhaancha bina jaye nahi ban sakti, par ticket ya toll ki kamai karz tatha byaj ka bojh nahi utha sakti; VGF ke tehat kul lagat ka ek tay hissa sarkar deti hai. Exam point: Bahut munafe wale niji project, videsh mein bane project tatha keval kheti se jude project is yojana ke daayre nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: The 'SHREYAS' scheme and industrial training focus on which aspect of the labor force?
qh: 'SHREYAS' योजना और औद्योगिक प्रशिक्षण श्रम शक्ति के किस पहलू पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं?
o: Skill development and apprenticeship for graduates
e: Shram shakti ko kaushal tatha industrial training se tayar karne wali yojana SHREYAS hai, jismein degree wale yuvaon ko udyog mein apprenticeship ke saath anshad ka sahaara milta hai. Yah tareeka isliye chuna gaya ki keval kagaz ki degree hone par bhi naukri nahi milti thi, isliye padhai ke saath karkhane ka tajurba jodkar yuvaon ko taiyaar karne ka lakshya rakha gaya; iska poora naam Scheme for Higher Education Youth in Apprenticeship and Skills hai. Exam point: Kaamkaji ki sankhya ghatana, kisaanon ki aay badhana tatha riyayati umar badhana is yojana ke uddeshya nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain.

qe: Under the National Food Security Act 2013, how much foodgrain per person per month is given to priority households?
qh: राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम 2013 के तहत अग्रणी परिवारों को प्रति व्यक्ति प्रति माह कितना अनाज दिया जाता है?
e: NFSA yaani rastriya khady suraksha adhiniyam 2013 ke tehat agrani gharanaon ko prati vyakti prati mahina paanch kilogram anaj milta hai, isliye itni rashi is adhiniyam ki pahchan hai. Yah rashi isliye tay ki gayi ki gaon tatha sheher ke gareeb ghar ke khaane ki zarurat puri ho sake tatha unhe bazaar ke badalte daam se bachaya ja sake. Do, saat tatha das kilogram wale vikalp is adhiniyam ke aankde nahi hain, isliye ye sahi nahi hain. In teeno vikalpon ki matra adhiniyam se mel nahi khaati. Exam point: agrani gharane ko prati vyakti prati mahina 5 kg tatha antyoday (AAY) gharane ko prati parivar prati mahina 35 kg anaj milta hai.

qe: How much foodgrain is given per family per month under the Antyodaya Anna Yojana?
qh: अंत्योदय अन्न योजना के तहत प्रति परिवार प्रति माह कितना अनाज दिया जाता है?
e: Antyoday Anna Yojana ke tehat sabse gareeb yaani 'antyoday' parivaron ko prati mahina paintis kilogram anaj milta hai, isliye yahi is yojana ka aankda hai. Yah anaj isliye zyada diya jaata hai ki ve gharane bazaar se khaana khareedne ki sthiti mein nahi hote, isliye unhe poore mahine ka saaman ek jagah mil jaata hai. Das, pachchis tatha pachas kilogram wale vikalp sarkari maap se mel nahi khaate tatha galat matra batate hain. Yah teeno vikalp adhoori ya badhi hui rashi dikhate hain. Exam point: antyoday parivar ko prati mahina 35 kg anaj milta hai - yahi is yojana ko alag banata hai.

qe: Which of the following is the main task of the Food Corporation of India (FCI)?
qh: भारतीय खाद्य निगम (FCI) का मुख्य कार्य निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा है?
o: न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य पर अनाज खरीदना तथा बफर स्टॉक रखना (Procurement at MSP and buffer stock)
उपभोक्ताओं को सीधे सोना बेचना (Selling gold to consumers)
खाद्य तेल का आयात करना (Importing edible oil)
e: FCI ka mukhya kaam MSP yaani nyoonatam samarthan moolya par kisaano se anaj kharidna tatha buffer stock yaani aarakshit bhandar sambhalna hai, isliye yah khady suraksha ki vyavastha ka bada stambh hai. Yah kharid isliye hoti hai ki kisaanon ko kam daam par bechne ki majboori na pade tatha sarkar ke paas saaman bacha rahe, jise zarurat ke samay PDS tatha anya yojnaon ke zariye baanta jaata hai. Sona bechna, beej baantna tatha khady tel ka aayatan is nigam ke sahi kaam nahi hain, kyunki ye anya sansthaon tatha vibhagon ke kaam hain. Yah teeno vikalp galat kaam batate hain. Exam point: FCI MSP par kharid tatha buffer stock rakhta hai tatha PDS ke liye anaj pahunchata hai.

qe: What is the main aim of the One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) scheme?
qh: 'एक राष्ट्र एक राशन कार्ड' (ONORC) योजना का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: किसी भी राज्य में राशन कार्ड से पात्र लाभार्थी को अनाज दिलाना (Portability of ration across states)
राशन कार्ड की संख्या घटाना (Reducing the number of ration cards)
खाद्य सब्सिडी को पूरी तरह बंद करना (Ending food subsidy)
केवल शहरों में राशन बाँटना (Urban-only distribution)
e: ONORC ka maksad yah hai ki paatra labharthi desh ke kisi bhi rajya mein apne rasan card se anaj le sake, isliye yah portability yaani ek jagah ka card doosri jagah chalne wali vyavastha hai. Yah suvidha isliye zaroori hui ki kaam ke liye doosre rajya jaane wale mazdooron ko wahan naya card banane ki lambi prakriya se guzarna padta tha. Cardon ki ginti ghatana, sabsidi band karna tatha keval shehron mein baantna is yojana ke sahi maksad nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp yojana ke ulat kaam dikhate hain. Exam point: ONORC se rasan card desh bhar mein ek jaisa chalta hai tatha pravasi mazdooron ko bada fayda mila.

qe: Under the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY), how much free grain is given per person per month?
qh: प्रधानमंत्री गरीब कल्याण अन्न योजना (PMGKAY) के तहत प्रति व्यक्ति प्रति माह कितना अनाज निःशुल्क दिया जाता है?
e: PMGKAY ke tehat prati vyakti prati mahina paanch kilogram anaj bilkul free diya jaata hai, isliye yah yojana khady suraksha ke aam kaam se alag hai. Yah yojana isliye shuru ki gayi ki mahamari ke samay kaam tatha kamai chhin gayi thi, isliye gareeb gharanaon ko khaana bina paise ke pahunchane ki zarurat padi. Do, das tatha pandrah kilogram wale vikalp is yojana ke aankde nahi hain tatha sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp yaad rakhne yogya matra nahi hain. Exam point: PMGKAY mein prati vyakti prati mahina 5 kg anaj free milta hai tatha yah yojana NFSA ke labharthiyon ke liye hai.

qe: In which year was the Antyodaya Anna Yojana launched?
qh: अंत्योदय अन्न योजना किस वर्ष शुरू की गई थी?
e: Antyoday Anna Yojana 25 December 2000 ko shuru ki gayi thi, isliye yahi iska sahi varsh hai. Yah yojana isliye shuru hui ki alag rah gaye gareebtam parivar PDS ke saaman tak nahi pahunch paate the, isliye unhe alag pahchan dekar sasta anaj dene ka raasta nikala gaya. 1997, 2013 tatha 2016 wale vikalp anya yojnaon tatha kanoonon ke saal hain tatha is yojana ke nahi hain. Is yojana ka asli saal in vikalpon se alag hai. Exam point: Antyoday Anna Yojana 2000 mein shuru hui tatha ismein parivar ko 35 kg anaj milta hai.
